title: 南极冰川下与帝企鹅的奇妙邂逅
promptEn: Prompt Image 1:- A wide-angle selfie photograph in Antarctica showing a man sitting on the snow, surrounded by a large colony of Emperor penguins. The man has short dark hair, a full beard, and is wearing red-lensed metal-frame sunglasses, a dark blue unbuttoned denim jacket over a white crew-neck t-shirt, dark blue cargo pants, and a brown canvas backpack. He is leaning slightly back, holding an orange smartphone in his right hand to take the selfie, with his left hand near the backpack strap. Around him, dozens of adult Emperor penguins are standing and walking on the snow, some close to the camera and others stretching into the distance. The background features massive towering glaciers and ice mountains with white cliffs and blue ice formations, deep snow with visible footprints, and a clear bright blue sky. Bright natural daylight creates crisp shadows, with sharp focus on the man, penguins, and the vast icy landscape, captured from a slightly low perspective that emphasizes scale and isolation. Prompt Image 2:- A highly detailed, cinematic wide-angle photograph in Antarctica: a handsome young man with short dark neatly styled hair, a full trimmed beard, and a confident expression is kneeling on one knee in the deep snow, gently shaking hands / holding flipper with a large adult Emperor penguin standing upright in front of him. The man is wearing red-tinted metal-frame aviator sunglasses, a dark blue unbuttoned denim jacket over a white crew-neck t-shirt, dark blue cargo pants, brown canvas backpack with straps over both shoulders, white Nike sneakers, and a wristwatch. He is looking at the penguin with a slight smile, his right hand clasping the penguin's flipper. The Emperor penguin is life-size, black head with yellow-orange neck patches, looking directly at the man. Surrounding them is a vast icy Antarctic landscape with massive towering glaciers, snow-covered mountains, blue ice formations, and distant icebergs under a clear bright blue sky. Crisp natural daylight, sharp shadows, high detail on textures of snow, denim fabric, penguin feathers, and facial features. Slightly low camera angle to emphasize scale and adventure, photorealistic style, sharp focus throughout, vibrant yet natural colors & heartwarming composition.

promptEn: TASK: Use the subject from the uploaded photo as the exact person in the final image. SUBJECT RULES (STRICT): - Use the uploaded photo as the sole reference for the person. - Preserve the subject’s identity, facial features, body proportions, hairstyle, clothing, and overall likeness. - Do NOT change the subject’s face, age, gender, or identity. - Do NOT stylize the subject into a cartoon or illustration. - The subject must remain fully photorealistic. SCENE & COMPOSITION: Create a surreal, cinematic photograph of the subject suspended in mid-air, floating as if gently falling, frozen in perfect stillness high above the Earth. The subject’s body appears weightless with a natural falling posture. Clothing and loose elements subtly ripple in the wind. ENVIRONMENT: - High-altitude sky scene above the cloud layer. - Overcast yet luminous sky with towering storm clouds breaking apart. - Soft, realistic sunlight rays piercing through gaps in the clouds. - Natural volumetric light beams and atmospheric depth. - Subtle cloud vapor and mist drifting around the subject. - A distant commercial passenger airplane appears in the background, small in scale, flying horizontally through the clouds. - The airplane must remain far behind the subject and never overlap or distract from them. - A few birds are also present at varying distances, closer than the airplane, with slight motion blur to reinforce depth and scale. LIGHTING & COLOR: - Ultra-realistic natural lighting. - Cool blues and soft whites dominate the palette. - Warm golden highlights from sunlight striking cloud edges and parts of the subject. - High dynamic range with realistic contrast. CAMERA & REALISM: - Cinematic photography style. - Realistic depth of field (no artificial or extreme blur). - Correct perspective and scale consistent with high altitude aviation. - No fantasy lighting, no glowing outlines, no surreal distortions beyond the floating effect. MOOD & STYLE: - Dramatic yet calm. - Minimalist composition. - Strong sense of altitude, silence, and suspension. - Hyper-realistic weather, clouds, and atmospheric detail. - Looks like a high-end cinematic still, not digital art. HARD RULES: - Do NOT change the subject’s identity or pose beyond floating. - Do NOT add text, logos, UI, or watermarks. - Do NOT introduce sci-fi or fantasy elements. - Keep everything physically believable and grounded in realism.
promptCh: 任务：使用上传照片中的人物作为最终图像中的确切人物。人物规则（严格）：- 仅使用上传的照片作为人物参考。- 保留人物的身份、面部特征、身体比例、发型、服装和整体形象。- 请勿改变人物的面部、年龄、性别或身份。- 请勿将人物风格化为卡通或插画。- 人物必须保持完全照片级真实感。场景与构图：创作一张超现实、电影感的照片，人物悬浮在半空中，仿佛轻轻坠落，在地球上方高处完美静止。人物身体显得失重，姿态自然下坠。服装和松散的元素在风中轻微波动。环境：- 云层上方的高空场景。- 阴沉但明亮的天空，高耸的积雨云正在散开。- 柔和、真实的阳光穿透云层缝隙。- 自然的体积光束和大气深度。- 围绕人物漂浮的细微云雾。- 背景中出现一架远处的商用客机，比例较小，在云中水平飞行。- 飞机必须保持在人物后方，不得与人物重叠或分散注意力。- 还有几只鸟，距离各异，比飞机更近，带有轻微的运动模糊，以增强深度和比例感。光照与色彩：- 超真实的自然光照。- 冷蓝色和柔和的白色为主色调。- 阳光照射云层边缘和人物部分时产生的温暖金色高光。- 高动态范围，具有真实的对比度。相机与真实感：- 电影摄影风格。- 真实的景深（无人工或极端模糊）。- 符合高空飞行的正确透视和比例。- 除了漂浮效果外，无奇幻光照、无发光轮廓、无超现实扭曲。情绪与风格：- 戏剧性而平静。- 极简构图。- 强烈的高空感、寂静感和悬浮感。- 超真实的 F 天气、云层和大气细节。- 看起来像高端电影剧照，而非数字艺术。硬性规则：- 除了漂浮姿态外，请勿改变人物的身份或姿势。- 请勿添加文本、徽标、UI 或水印。- 请勿引入科幻或奇幻元素。- 保持一切在物理上可信，并立足于现实。

title: 现代湿婆多臂职业精英超写实商业大片
promptEn: **[USER_PHOTO]** **[PROFESSION]** Create a hyper-real, studio portrait using [USER_PHOTO] as the exact identity reference (same face, hairstyle, skin texture, and age). Depict the person as a confident [PROFESSION] sitting casually on a modern white ergonomic office chair, legs crossed, centered in frame. Add a stylized “multi-arm” illusion (6–8 arms total) radiating behind the torso like a modern Shiva/Vishnu-inspired silhouette, but photorealistic: each extra arm must have correct anatomy, believable joints, tendons, skin pores, and natural shadowing; no warped fingers. PROPS (must be profession-relevant): Automatically choose and place different tools that a real [PROFESSION] would use, one per hand/arm, all clearly readable and accurate in design. Examples of categories: primary tool, secondary tool, communication device, measurement/diagnostic tool, accessory, and a “hero” prop. Keep one real smartphone in the main/front hand. Avoid generic random objects—every prop must logically belong to [PROFESSION]. If [PROFESSION] is digital/tech: include items like laptop, tablet, camera/monitor, light meter, stylus, keyboard, mic, etc. If [PROFESSION] is medical: stethoscope, clipboard, otoscope, syringe (safe/clinical), etc. If [PROFESSION] is culinary: chef knife, tongs, plating tweezers, recipe tablet, etc. (Always match [PROFESSION].) BACKGROUND COLOR (topic-matched): Use a seamless paper studio backdrop with a single dominant color that matches the profession theme (e.g., warm mustard for creative/media, cool teal for healthcare, graphite/steel for engineering, rich olive for outdoors, deep burgundy for luxury). The color should complement skin tones and wardrobe. Add subtle gradient falloff and soft bounce for depth (no flat background). LIGHTING & SET: High-end commercial studio look. One large soft key light from camera-left, controlled fill from right, crisp rim light to separate subject, and realistic specular highlights on props. Include a large circular silver reflector disk behind the subject (partially visible) for visual punch. Add a subtle shadow on the floor consistent with light direction. WARDROBE & STYLING: Outfit must be believable for a top-tier [PROFESSION] (clean, modern, slightly stylized), with texture detail (fabric weave, seams). Add minimal accessories (watch/bracelet) that feel premium. Expression: focused, slightly intense, “in the zone.” COMPOSITION & CAMERA: Full-body vertical portrait (4:5), 50mm lens look, eye-level camera, sharp focus on face, shallow depth of field but props still readable. Ultra-detailed skin, natural color grading, high dynamic range, crisp micro-contrast. REALISM RULES: No cartoon, no CGI look. No extra faces, no duplicated heads. Hands must be anatomically correct (5 fingers), no melted objects, no unreadable text logos unless naturally present. Keep the scene clean and premium.

title: 三大女星湿发高定极简大片
promptEn: "A hyper-realistic cinematic portrait captures three prominent actresses Sydney Sweeney, Sadie Sink, and Ana de Armas standing side-by-side in a sophisticated, minimalist architectural space with muted grey concrete walls. Sydney, on the left, wears a cream-colored silk corset gown with sheer paneling; Sadie, in the center, dons a vibrant scarlet red one-shoulder dress with geometric cutouts; and Ana, on the right, faces away to showcase a backless black lace evening gown. All three women sport a coordinated "wet look" aesthetic with damp, slicked-back hair and luminous, dewy skin that catches the soft, directional overhead lighting. The composition is intimate and powerful, utilizing a shallow depth of field and a moody, high-fashion color palette to emphasize the intricate textures of the fabric and the striking gaze of the subjects."
promptCh: 一幅超写实的电影感肖像，捕捉了三位著名女演员——西德尼·斯威尼（Sydney Sweeney）、萨迪·辛克（Sadie Sink）和安娜·德·阿玛斯（Ana de Armas）——并肩站立在精致、极简的建筑空间中，背景是柔和的灰色混凝土墙。左侧的西德尼身着一件奶油色丝绸紧身胸衣礼服，带有薄纱拼接；中间的萨迪则穿着一件鲜艳的猩红色单肩连衣裙，带有几何镂空设计；右侧的安娜背对镜头，展示着一件露背黑色蕾丝晚礼服。三位女性都以协调的“湿发造型”示人，头发湿润并向后梳理，皮肤光泽水润，捕捉着柔和、定向的顶部照明。构图亲密而有力，利用浅景深和情绪化的时尚调色板，强调了面料的精细纹理和拍摄对象引人注目的凝视。

promptEn: A surreal hyper-realistic cinematic video of a colossal macaron megastructure under construction, envisioned as a futuristic architectural spire made entirely of oversized pastel macarons. Each macaron tier functions like a rotating skyscraper floor, subtly spiraling upward as the structure grows. Tiny miniature construction workers in reflective vests, hard hats, harnesses, and safety gear move with purposeful realism: rappelling down macaron surfaces, welding delicate sugar-like support ribs, laser-measuring seams, signaling to cranes, and guiding a levitating macaron layer suspended by synchronized cables. A massive yellow crane slowly lifts the top macaron into place while smaller cranes, excavators, and dump trucks operate below on a powdered-sugar terrain. Camera movement is cinematic and deliberate: slow vertical crane-up shots revealing scale, macro close-ups of textured macaron shells and creamy fillings, then wide aerial pulls showing the entire tower disappearing into thick vanilla-tinted fog. Volumetric god rays pierce the mist, soft particles float in the air, and subtle motion blur enhances realism. Lighting is dramatic yet elegant, blending industrial grit with whimsical luxury. Ultra-detailed photorealistic textures contrast smooth dessert surfaces with worn construction machinery. Dreamlike but believable physics, gentle ambient motion, no abrupt cuts, seamless transitions. Vertical composition, epic scale contrast, surreal food-architecture world, cinematic depth of field, 8K realism, slow majestic pacing. title: 电影级四分屏多视角叙事
promptEn: Create a single cinematic image divided into four horizontal panels, each panel representing a different camera angle of the same scene and subject. All panels must be visually cohesive in lighting, color grading, and atmosphere. Top panel – BIRD’S-EYE SHOT: A top-down overhead view, perfectly vertical camera angle, emphasizing spatial layout and geometry. Second panel – SIDE CLOSE-UP SHOT: A close-up shot from the side profile, shallow depth of field, focusing on facial or object details with cinematic compression. Third panel – EXTREME CLOSE-UP: An extreme close-up capturing fine textures and micro details, filling the frame almost abstractly. Bottom panel – MEDIUM WIDE BACK SHOT: A medium-wide shot from behind the subject, showing posture and environment, cinematic framing, strong sense of depth. Clean horizontal separations between panels, editorial film-strip composition, high-end cinematic still, consistent subject identity across all panels.
promptCh: 创作一张电影风格的图像，将其分成四个水平面板，每个面板都代表同一场景和主题的不同摄像机角度。 所有面板在光照、色彩分级和氛围上必须保持视觉上的连贯性。 顶部面板 – 鸟瞰镜头： 自上而下的俯视视角，摄像机角度完全垂直，强调空间布局和几何结构。 第二个面板 – 侧面特写镜头： 侧面轮廓的特写镜头，景深较浅，通过电影压缩聚焦于面部或物体细节。 第三个面板 – 超特写镜头： 捕捉精细纹理和微观细节的超特写镜头，几乎抽象地填满整个画面。 底部面板 – 中景广角背部镜头： 从主体背后拍摄的中景广角镜头，展示姿态和环境，电影般的构图，强烈的景深感。 面板之间采用清晰的水平分隔，编辑电影胶片构图，高端电影剧照，所有面板中的主体身份保持一致。

promptEn: name: "Reality-First Prompt primary_use: "Image generation prompt creation (photoreal, editorial-documentary, product, architecture, nature, illustration/3D if requested)" works_for: ["people", "objects", "animals", "food", "interiors", "architecture", "landscapes", "abstract concepts (by grounding into visible cues)"] mission: > Write high-control prompts that reliably produce believable, real-world results by anchoring hard constraints, describing observable details, defining one priority focus, and adding strict negatives to prevent common artifacts. why_it_works: - "Front-loads non-negotiables (aspect ratio, medium, shot type, location/time, framing)." - "Uses domain language (camera/light/material behavior) instead of vague aesthetics." - "Defines realism with observable cues (micro-texture, imperfections, separation)." - "Adds disambiguation clauses to prevent frequent model failure modes." - "Strong strict negatives target the 'AI look' and unwanted styles." - "Avoids contradictions; keeps one coherent lighting/color pipeline." operating_principles: - "Hard constraints first; never bury them." - "Write like a photographer/designer: measurable, stageable, physically plausible." - "Pick ONE primary focus and define it using 3–8 observable features." - "Convert style words into camera/light/material behaviors (not filters)." - "Specify color & light explicitly: white balance, warmth, contrast, exposure, saturation rules." - "Specify camera behavior: lens/phone realism, DoF/focus falloff, grain, edge softness, motion blur." - "Use strict negatives as guardrails; keep them targeted and non-contradictory." - "No contradictory instructions (e.g., 'accurate WB' + 'heavy teal-orange grade')." required_inputs: - key: "subject" description: "What to depict (who/what), specific nouns." examples: ["a ceramic mug with visible glaze crazing", "a mountain bike leaning against a wall"] - key: "medium" description: "Photo / smartphone photo / film photo / 3D render / illustration (must be explicit)." examples: ["ultra-realistic smartphone photo", "35mm film photo", "studio product photo"] - key: "aspect_ratio" description: "Orientation and ratio." examples: ["9:16 vertical", "1:1 square", "3:2 horizontal"] - key: "setting" description: "Where + time-of-day + primary light source." examples: ["indoors near a window during daytime", "overcast outdoor street, late afternoon"] - key: "shot" description: "Framing + angle + distance + occlusions if any." examples: ["close-up from collarbone to top of head", "top-down tabletop shot, 50cm distance"] - key: "primary_focus" description: "ONE priority: what must look correct/real." examples: ["skin realism", "material realism", "typography accuracy", "motion re"
promptCh: name: "现实优先提示词" primary_use: "图像生成提示词创建（真实感、编辑纪实、产品、建筑、自然、插画/3D，如需）" works_for: ["人物", "物体", "动物", "食物", "室内", "建筑", "风景", "抽象概念（通过具象化为可见线索）"] mission: > 通过锚定硬性约束、描述可观察细节、定义一个优先焦点并添加严格的负面提示词来防止常见伪影， 编写高可控性提示词，以可靠地生成可信的、真实世界的结果。 why_it_works: - "优先处理不可协商的要素（长宽比、媒介、拍摄类型、位置/时间、构图）。" - "使用领域语言（相机/光线/材质行为）而非模糊的美学描述。" - "通过可观察的线索（微观纹理、瑕疵、分离度）定义真实感。" - "添加消歧条款以防止常见的模型故障模式。" - "强有力的严格负面提示词针对“AI 风格”和不必要的样式。" - "避免矛盾；保持一个连贯的照明/色彩流程。" operating_principles: - "硬性约束优先；绝不将其埋藏在深处。" - "像摄影师/设计师一样写作：可衡量、可布置、物理上合理。" - "选择一个主要焦点，并使用 3-8 个可观察特征来定义它。" - "将风格词转换为相机/光线/材质行为（而非滤镜）。" - "明确指定颜色和光线：白平衡、暖度、对比度、曝光、饱和度规则。" - "指定相机行为：镜头/手机真实感、景深/焦点衰减、颗粒感、边缘柔和度、运动模糊。" - "使用严格的负面提示词作为护栏；保持其有针对性且不矛盾。" - "避免矛盾指令（例如，“准确的白平衡”+“强烈的青橙色调”）。" required_inputs: - key: "subject" description: "描绘什么（谁/什么），具体的名词。" examples: ["一个带有明显釉面开裂的陶瓷马克杯", "一辆靠墙的山地自行车"] - key: "medium" description: "照片 / 智能手机照片 / 胶片照片 / 3D 渲染 / 插画（必须明确）。" examples: ["超现实智能手机照片", "35mm 胶片照片", "影棚产品照片"] - key: "aspect_ratio" description: "方向和比例。" examples: ["9:16 竖屏", "1:1 正方形", "3:2 横屏"] - key: "setting" description: "地点 + 一天中的时间 + 主要光源。" examples: ["白天窗户旁的室内", "阴天室外街道，傍晚"] - key: "shot" description: "构图 + 角度 + 距离 + 如有遮挡物。" examples: ["从锁骨到头顶的特写", "俯视桌面拍摄，距离 50 厘米"] - key: "primary_focus" description: "一个优先事项：什么必须看起来正确/真实。" examples: ["皮肤真实感", "材质真实感", "排版准确性", "运动真实感"

title: 雨夜都市回眸的金发少年
promptEn: A high-definition, cinematic portrait of a young man with wavy blonde hair, looking over his shoulder with a serious expression. He is standing on a crowded, rainy city street at night. The background is filled with intense, warm golden bokeh from city lights and traffic, contrasting with cool blue tones in the upper atmosphere. Rain droplets and golden dust particles are caught in the light, creating a shimmering, ethereal atmosphere. Sharp focus on the subject's face, shallow depth of field, photorealistic, shot on 35mm lens, moody lighting.

title: 从平面蓝图到温暖实景的跨越
promptEn: The image uses a left-right split composition, with a clear boundary between the left and right halves, aligned overall, presenting a comparison effect of "concept map versus actual implementation". The left half is a highly detailed modern minimalist architectural floor plan illustration, consistent with the reference image style. It shows a top-down orthogonal projection of the residential layout, clearly labeling spaces and circulation: living room, dining area, open kitchen, bedroom, entrance hall, corridor and flow lines, balcony or loggia space, bay window, and window opening locations. The color scheme uses neutral beige and warm gray, with clean lines, slight soft shadows, and delicate material textures, showcasing the quality of the interior design plan, presented in a blueprint-style flat visual, with visible and accurately scaled furniture placement. The right half is an ultra-realistic interior photo effect of the same living room as the left floor plan, with spatial proportions and layout strictly corresponding to the floor plan. The living room includes a curved sofa set, a central coffee table, soft carpet, warm wooden floor, neutral walls, and large windows introducing natural light. The overall style is modern and warm home atmosphere, with earthy tones and soft lighting, realistic and tactile materials, details that feel lived-in yet remain neat and restrained. The right side presents a real interior photography texture, with clear textures and high-resolution details. The style and atmosphere combine architectural visualization with real interior photography, modern, warm, elegant, conveying the professional design studio presentation feel, emphasizing the contrast between the plan and the actual scene. Lighting and color requirements: The left side uses uniform flat light and neutral colors, while the right side uses natural daylight with soft shadows and warm highlights; the colors on both sides maintain a unified harmonious relationship. Lens and technical requirements: The left side is a top-down orthogonal view, and the right side is a flat view using an interior wide-angle lens, with sharp image clarity, rich real materials, and details. Negative prompt: cartoon style, rough details, messy interior, mismatch between floor plan and actual scene, distorted proportions, overly harsh light, exaggerated saturated colors, text overlay, watermark, logo, noise, blur.

promptCh: 阳光普照的现代入口建筑摄影，采用错层式设计。前景中，光亮的深色木地板过渡到带有斑驳米色水磨石台阶的抬高平台。左侧是线条简洁的木制楼梯。空间沐浴在透过后方法式门窗射入的温暖自然阳光中，树枝的独特艺术斑驳阴影投射在地板表面。郁郁葱葱的室内盆栽植物，包括一棵大型榕树，增添了鲜艳的绿色点缀。右侧，一张带有鼠尾草绿色坐垫的木制储物长凳和一张摆放着茶具的边桌，营造出舒适的起居区氛围。色彩以温暖的大地色调、米色、木色和奶油色为主。图像清晰、高分辨率，捕捉了高端室内设计杂志中常见的宁静、通透的氛围。 ## 主题与特征 主要主题：室内入口和起居空间 主题类型：建筑/室内设计 外观：线条简洁、错层式地板、开放式布局 配饰：带框植物艺术品、陶瓷盆、茶具、坐垫 动作：静态建筑场景 比例：建筑比例 ## 灯光分析 灯光类型：自然阳光 方向：窗户侧面和背光 质量：透过树木过滤的强烈阳光，形成斑驳图案 色温：温暖的黄金时段（约 3500K-4000K） 阴影：地板上清晰、高对比度的树枝阴影 高光：水磨石和木材上的明亮阳光斑块 时间：下午晚些时候或清晨 灯光设置：自然环境补光，带有强烈定向阳光 ## 色彩搭配 主色调：#8B5A2B（中等木色）、#E8E0D5（米色水磨石）、#F5F5F0（米白色墙壁）、#4A6B4A（叶绿色）、#CCA878（阳光金色） 调色板：类似色系的暖色调，带有绿色点缀 配色方案：大地色系 色温：暖色 对比度：中高，由于阳光和阴影的 interplay 饱和度：自然，略带暖色和活力 色彩分级：自然，温暖的室内风格 点缀色：绿色植物，彩色水磨石斑点 ## 构图与相机 相机角度：平视 拍摄类型：室内广角镜头 焦距：24mm 或 35mm 广角 景深：深景深（f/8 或 f/11） 透视：一点透视 三分法构图：楼梯在左三分之一处，树木在左中，家具在右三分之一处 引导线：地板和楼梯扶手指向后门 对称性：不对称平衡 负空间：平衡使用，通透感 构图元素：左侧楼梯，右侧木制家具 前景：木地板和家具边缘 中景：水磨石平台和大型室内树木 背景：通往绿色花园的法式门 ## 环境与背景 地点类型：室内住宅门厅 背景：带花园通道的现代住宅 天气：晴朗 氛围：明亮、阳光充足、宁静 季节：春季或夏季

title: 千禧超现实：红底鞋上的梦幻微缩人
狗仔风私人客舱叛逆拽妹
promptEn: "Ultra-realistic raw DSLR paparazzi-style cinematic portrait of a young woman from the reference image — shot inside a beige leather private jet cabin. Tight waist-up crop, very close camera distance, slightly high-angle perspective, as if captured quickly from the aisle in a candid moment. The subject leans forward casually, torso angled slightly left, head tilted subtly right.Her expression is unapologetically playful and rebellious: a wide grin with tongue fully out, teeth exposed, cheeks raised, jaw relaxed and loose. Eyes locked directly into the lens through thin oval metal-frame glasses with lightly tinted lenses; eyes in razor-sharp focus while everything else falls off naturally. Both hands lifted near the chest, elbows bent, palms inward, clearly flipping both middle fingers toward the camera in a spontaneous, unfiltered gesture. Hair appears natural and unstyled, without emphasis on length, color, or shape — no idealization or aesthetic exaggeration. Skin is fully realistic and unretouched: natural tone variations, visible pores, fine lines, micro-imperfections, slight oil sheen, authentic highlights on the forehead and nose, organic shadow transitions — absolutely no smoothing, beauty filters, or artificial skin effects. She wears a white graphic T-shirt, a black leather cross-body bag strap hanging naturally across the torso, a silver chain necklace, and a small hoop earring. Tattooed forearms are clearly visible with authentic ink texture, slight skin stretch, and real pigment absorption. Lighting is harsh natural cabin light from camera-left mixed with ambient overhead lighting, creating slightly uneven exposure, mild blown highlights, gritty contrast, and natural shadowing under the cheekbones and jawline. Background shows blurred beige jet seats and indistinct figures, shallow depth of field with imperfect focus falloff and organic lens blur. DSLR look, paparazzi candid energy, subtle grain, imperfect framing, real-world color cast, film-like RAW processing, HDR realism, non-AI aesthetic, natural proportions, documentary-style authenticity."
promptCh: “一张超逼真的原始数码单反狗仔队风格电影肖像，描绘了一位参考图片中的年轻女性——拍摄于米色皮革私人飞机机舱内。紧凑的半身特写，相机距离非常近，略微高角度视角，仿佛在不经意间从过道快速捕捉。 拍摄对象随意地前倾，躯干略微向左倾斜，头部微微向右倾斜。她的表情 unapologetically 顽皮而叛逆：咧嘴大笑，舌头完全伸出，露出牙齿，脸颊上扬，下巴放松而松弛。眼睛透过薄薄的椭圆形金属框眼镜，镜片略带茶色，直视镜头；眼睛聚焦锐利，而其他一切自然虚化。 双手举至胸前，手肘弯曲，手掌向内，明显地向镜头竖起两根中指，这是一个自发、未经修饰的姿态。头发自然，未经造型，不强调长度、颜色或形状——没有理想化或审美夸张。 皮肤完全真实，未经修饰：自然的肤色变化，可见的毛孔，细纹，微小瑕疵，轻微的油光，额头和鼻子的真实高光，自然的阴影过渡——绝对没有平滑、美颜滤镜或人工皮肤效果。 她穿着一件白色印花 T 恤，一条黑色皮革斜挎包带自然地挂在躯干上，一条银色项链，以及一只小耳环。纹身的前臂清晰可见，具有真实的墨水质感，轻微的皮肤拉伸和真实的色素吸收。 光线是来自相机左侧的刺眼自然机舱光线与环境顶灯混合，造成轻微不均匀的曝光，轻微过曝的高光，粗糙的对比度，以及颧骨和下颌线下的自然阴影。背景显示模糊的米色飞机座椅和模糊不清的人物，浅景深，焦点虚化不完美，以及自然的镜头模糊。 数码单反外观，狗仔队抓拍的能量，细微的颗粒感，不完美的构图，真实世界的偏色，电影般的 RAW 处理，HDR 真实感，非 AI 美学，自然比例，纪录片式的真实性。”

title: 悬浮峡谷石桥微缩沙盘
promptEn: SCENE: A trading settlement built around a large stone bridge crossing a deep river gorge with shops, storage sheds, and stairways leading to dock platforms below. Tiny traders move goods while birds glide along canyon walls. STYLE: Create a premium stylized miniature diorama where canyon terrain and river water form a continuous sculpted base integrated with market structures. The entire diorama floats in mid-air inside a blank single-color background environment that contrasts with the rocky terrain. Use stylized resin water, compact shops, and rope docks. Include miniature traders, carts, birds, barrels, crates, and rope details to reinforce handcrafted miniature storytelling scale. Lock the render to 4:3. LIGHTING: The scene occurs in late evening after sunset with very low natural light. Ambient lighting remains dim while lanterns, shop lights, and small lamps illuminate the bridge and market stalls. These lights create warm glowing pockets of illumination across the trading post while surrounding canyon surfaces remain darker, producing strong contrast and dramatic miniature depth. CAMERA: Use an isometric camera capturing the entire floating diorama clearly from top to bottom and side to side.
promptCh: 场景： 一个贸易聚落，围绕着一座横跨深邃河谷的巨大石桥而建，其间商店、储藏棚和通往下方码头平台的阶梯错落有致。小商贩们搬运货物，鸟儿们沿着峡谷峭壁滑翔。 风格： 创建一个精致的风格化微缩立体模型，其中峡谷地形和河水构成一个连续的雕塑基座，并与市场建筑融为一体。整个立体模型悬浮在一个空白的单色背景环境中，与岩石地形形成对比。使用风格化的树脂水、紧凑的商店和绳索码头。加入微缩商贩、手推车、鸟类、木桶、板条箱和绳索细节，以增强手工微缩模型的叙事感。将渲染锁定为 4:3。 光照： 场景发生在日落后的傍晚，自然光线非常微弱。环境光线保持昏暗，而灯笼、商店灯和小灯照亮了桥梁和市场摊位。这些灯光在贸易站上营造出温暖发光的照明区域，而周围的峡谷表面则保持较暗，从而产生强烈的对比和戏剧性的微缩景深。 镜头： 使用等距视角，清晰地捕捉整个悬浮立体模型，从上到下，从左到右。

title: 月下白城武士卧姿狙击
promptEn: Masterpiece quality, theatrical anime-scale dynamic battle scene. A samurai character is the main subject (preserving a traditional samurai feel, optionally blended with subtle modern gear elements). Prone firing pose (low-profile/propped close to the roof surface), body flattened to the tiles, elbows braced for stability. Cheek pressed to the stock while peering through the scope, one eye narrowed, an intense focused stare and clenched teeth conveying tension and determination. Composition and angle: the camera is placed almost on the roof tiles—an extreme ground-level ultra low-angle. Wide-angle lens with exaggerated perspective and strong depth. A diagonal composition: the sniper rifle runs from the extreme lower foreground into the midground, leading the viewer’s eye directly to the samurai’s gaze. The muzzle and muzzle flash dominate the extreme foreground, appearing oversized and close enough to “break the screen,” while the face (especially the eyes) stays crisp and sharp. Action: captured at the exact instant of firing. A large, stylized muzzle flash erupts in the foreground; sparks, glowing embers, and thin smoke burst outward. Ejected brass and scattered casings on the tiles reinforce the sense of ongoing fire. A faint luminous streak suggests the bullet’s path slicing through the night air. Subtle recoil pushes the rifle and shoulder back; dynamic motion blur on the weapon and sleeves, while the eyes and brow remain tack-sharp. The scope glass reflects a cold blue-green sheen; metal surfaces show finely detailed reflections and crisp edge highlights. Setting: the rooftop of a white Japanese castle keep (white plaster walls), under a clear night sky. Clean moonlight creates strong rim lighting along roof ridges and the samurai’s silhouette. Traditional roof features—curved ceramic tiles, ridge lines, gables, and shachihoko ornaments—read clearly in silhouette and detail. The firing shock and weight shift chip and crack tiles; fragments and dust jump up and arc toward the camera. High-contrast cinematic lighting with a dramatic warm–cool split: warm muzzle flash versus cool moonlight. Filmic particles (dust, embers) in the air. Vertical cinematic poster composition, 9:16 aspect ratio, no text.
promptCh: 大师级品质，影院级动画规模的动态战斗场景。一名武士角色是主要描绘对象（保留传统武士风格，可选择性地融入微妙的现代装备元素）。呈卧姿射击姿态（低姿态/紧贴屋顶表面），身体平伏在瓦片上，双肘支撑以保持稳定。脸颊紧贴枪托，透过瞄准镜窥视，一只眼睛微眯，专注而紧张的凝视和紧咬的牙关传达出紧张和决心。 构图与角度：摄像机几乎放置在屋顶瓦片上——极端的超低角度。广角镜头，透视夸张，景深强烈。对角线构图：狙击步枪从极近的前景延伸至中景，将观众的视线直接引向武士的目光。枪口和枪口火焰占据极近的前景，显得硕大，近到足以“破屏而出”，而脸部（尤其是眼睛）则保持清晰锐利。 动作：捕捉到射击的精确瞬间。巨大的、风格化的枪口火焰在前景爆发；火花、炽热的余烬和稀薄的烟雾向外喷射。弹出的黄铜弹壳和散落在瓦片上的弹壳增强了持续射击的感觉。一道微弱的发光轨迹暗示着子弹划破夜空。轻微的后坐力将步枪和肩膀向后推；武器和袖子有动态模糊，而眼睛和眉毛则保持锐利。瞄准镜玻璃反射出冷冽的蓝绿色光泽；金属表面显示出精细的反射和清晰的边缘高光。 场景：白色日本城堡天守阁（白色灰泥墙）的屋顶，在晴朗的夜空下。洁净的月光在屋脊和武士的轮廓上形成强烈的轮廓光。传统的屋顶特征——弯曲的陶瓷瓦片、屋脊线、山墙和鯱（shachihoko）装饰——在剪影和细节中清晰可见。射击的冲击和重心转移使瓦片碎裂；碎片和灰尘向上飞溅并弧形飞向摄像机。高对比度的电影级照明，具有戏剧性的冷暖色调分割：温暖的枪口火焰与清冷的月光形成对比。空气中有电影般的颗粒（灰尘、余烬）。 垂直电影海报构图，9:16 宽高比，无文字。

title: 城市十二时辰光影拼贴海报
promptEn:
Please create a high-completion, high-aesthetic, suitable-for-series-release vertical poster themed '【City Name】 Twelve Shichen (Twelve Hours)' for 【City Name】.

【Core Positioning】
This is not an ordinary travel collage, nor a single landscape poster, but a city-themed collage poster with a 'sense of time narrative, city recognition, series cover feel, and magazine feature feel'. The overall look should be like a standard main poster in a mature content column or cultural tourism visual series, with exquisite, unified, clear, and viral images.

【Format Requirements】
- Fixed vertical poster composition
- Aspect ratio recommended as 3:4
- Must have a 'large poster feel' and high-resolution texture
- Suitable for mobile browsing, as well as for content covers and series release images

【Layout Structure】
The entire poster must consist of 12 images, using a fixed 3-column × 4-row layout structure, totaling 12 visual units, forming a clear collage grid. Each small image should be relatively independent and visually appealing, but must maintain unity with the whole, not looking like a messy collage of screenshots.

【Theme Logic】
The poster theme is '【City Name】 Twelve Shichen'. The 12 images need to revolve around the same city, forming a complete timeline from sunrise to sunset, and then to the falling of night, reflecting the changes in the city's temperament during different periods of the day. The images must have a clear sense of time progression, rather than randomly placing 12 city landscapes.

【Content Requirements】
1. Must include the most representative key landmarks, cityscapes, or iconic scenes of 【City Name】.
2. Landmarks should be naturally distributed across the 12 images, without mechanical repetition, and do not just photograph the same building in every grid.
3. Scene content can include: city skyline, landmark buildings, blocks, cultural spaces, bridges, water areas, parks, historical buildings, night views, city life atmosphere, etc.
4. Different time periods should have different lighting and atmosphere changes, for example: dawn, early morning, morning, noon, afternoon, evening, sunset, blue hour, early night, city night view.
5. The overall should reflect the fluidity, rhythm, and layering of the same city within a single day.

【Visual Style】
- Overall mainly features a sense of realistic photography, cultural tourism feature feel, and city magazine feel
- Has unified color grading and a sense of series
- Images are exquisite, clean, and orderly
- Combines a premium feel, documentary temperament, and viral cover attributes
- Can have a slight cinematic feel, but do not over-retouch to the point of distortion
- Every small image must be beautiful, but more importantly, the overall unity

【Color and Lighting】
- The overall color should change naturally with the timeline, from morning light to day, from evening to night, forming a continuous color temperature change
- Changes such as sunrise warm gold, daytime clear, dusk orange gold, nightfall blue tone, and night view warm lights are allowed
- But the overall post-production tone still needs to be unified, and each grid cannot look like a different filter
- Emphasize the sky, water surface, building lights, city layers, and sense of air

【Title Design】
The main title of the poster is: '【City Name】 Twelve Shichen'
Requirements:
1. The title must be clearly readable, serving as the series' main visual.
2. There must be good visual balance between the title and the images, and a whole black mask cannot be simply and roughly pressed behind the text.
3. Text readability needs to be handled in a more premium way, for example: reasonable white space, local darkening, soft gradients, slight blurring, light and shadow avoidance, semi-transparent delicate backing, or letting the title fall in a position more suitable for reading.
4. The title must be prominent, but cannot destroy the overall aesthetic of the base image.
5. Can be paired with small-area subtitles, seals, time tags, or light decorative elements, but not too many.

【Layout and Visual Center of Gravity】
- The 12-grid collage is the main structure
- The title is the main visual anchor
- Need to reorganize the composition so that the text and collage content form a balance, rather than a rigid overlay
- The overall reading logic should be clear: see the title first, then browse the 12 time slices, and then feel the one-day changes of the whole city
- Must have a clear poster feel, rather than an ordinary puzzle screenshot

【Quality Requirements】
- Images must be clean, unified, premium, and design-oriented
- There must be both differences and consistency among the 12 images
- Clear landmarks, high city recognition
- Clear timeline, distinct theme
- Mature and natural title layout
- Avoid clutter, avoid out-of-control collage, avoid rigid text-over-image, avoid low-quality tourism promotional image feel

【Replaceable Fields】
【City Name】 = User-specified city
【Style Tendency】 = Cultural tourism feel / Magazine feel / Documentary feel / Urban premium feel / Historical and humanistic feel
【Main Color Temperament】 = Morning pale gold / Clear blue-green / Dusk orange gold / Nightfall deep blue / City neon, etc.
【Title Style】 = Chinese calligraphy feel / Modern title font / Literary magazine font / City feature font
【Sub-elements】 = Small seal / Small tag / Time sequence mark / Minimalist subtitle

If the user only inputs a city name, please automatically understand and complete:
- The most representative landmarks of the city
- The most suitable one-day timeline to express
- Typical scenes that best reflect the city's temperament
- The most reasonable lighting and color changes
promptCh:
请为【城市名】创作一张高完成度、高审美、适合系列化发布的「【城市名】十二时辰」主题竖版海报。

【核心定位】
这不是普通旅游拼图，也不是单张风景海报，而是一张具有“时间叙事感、城市识别度、系列封面感、杂志专题感”的城市主题拼贴海报。整体要像一个成熟内容栏目或文旅视觉系列中的标准主海报，画面精致、统一、清晰、具有传播感。

【画幅要求】
- 固定为竖版海报构图
- 比例建议为 3:4
- 要有“大海报感”和高分辨率质感
- 适合在移动端浏览，也适合做内容封面和系列发布图

【版式结构】
整张海报必须由 12 张图片组成，采用固定的 3 列 × 4 行结构排布，共 12 个画面单元，形成清晰的拼贴网格。每个小画面既要相对独立、具有观赏性，又必须与整体保持统一，不能像杂乱截图拼接。

【主题逻辑】
海报主题为“【城市名】十二时辰”。12 张图需要围绕同一座城市展开，并形成从日出到日落、再到夜幕降临的完整时间线，体现一天之内不同时间段的城市气质变化。画面要有明显的时间推进感，而不是随机摆放 12 张城市风景。

【内容要求】
1. 必须包含【城市名】最具代表性的重点地标、城市景观或标志性场景。
2. 地标应自然分布在 12 个画面中，不要机械重复，也不要每格都只拍同一个建筑。
3. 场景内容可包含：城市天际线、地标建筑、街区、人文空间、桥梁、水域、公园、历史建筑、夜景、城市生活氛围等。
4. 不同时间段应有不同光线和氛围变化，例如：晨曦、清晨、上午、正午、午后、傍晚、日落、蓝调时刻、夜幕初上、城市夜景。
5. 整体应体现同一城市在一天之中的流动感、节奏感和层次感。

【视觉风格】
- 整体以真实摄影感、文旅专题感、城市杂志感为主
- 具有统一调色和系列感
- 画面精致、干净、有秩序
- 兼具高级感、纪录片气质和传播封面属性
- 可以有轻微电影感，但不要过度修饰到失真
- 每个小画面都要漂亮，但更重要的是整体统一

【色彩与光影】
- 整体色彩要随时间线自然变化，从晨光到白天，从傍晚到夜色，形成连续的色温变化
- 允许出现日出暖金、白天清透、黄昏橙金、入夜蓝调、夜景暖灯等变化
- 但整体后期色调仍需统一，不能每格像不同滤镜
- 强调天空、水面、建筑灯光、城市层次与空气感

【标题设计】
海报主标题为：「【城市名】十二时辰」
要求：
1. 标题必须清晰可读，具有系列主视觉作用。
2. 标题与图片之间要有良好的视觉平衡，不能简单粗暴地在文字后面压一整块黑色遮罩。
3. 需要通过更高级的方式处理文字可读性，例如：合理留白、局部暗化、柔和渐变、轻微虚化、光影避让、半透明细腻衬底，或让标题落在更适合阅读的位置。
4. 标题既要突出，又不能破坏底图整体美感。
5. 可搭配小面积副标题、印章、时间标签或轻装饰元素，但不宜过多。

【排版与视觉重心】
- 12 格拼贴是主体结构
- 标题是主视觉锚点
- 需要重新组织构图，使文字与拼贴内容形成平衡，而不是生硬覆盖
- 整体阅读逻辑应清晰：先看到标题，再浏览 12 个时间切片，再感受整座城市的一日变化
- 要有明确的海报感，而不是普通拼图截图

【质量要求】
- 画面必须整洁、统一、高级、有设计感
- 12 张图片之间既有差异，也有一致性
- 地标清晰，城市辨识度高
- 时间线明确，主题鲜明
- 标题排版成熟自然
- 避免杂乱、避免拼贴失控、避免文字压图生硬、避免低质旅游宣传图感

【可替换字段】
【城市名】= 用户指定城市
【风格倾向】= 文旅感 / 杂志感 / 纪录片感 / 都市高级感 / 历史人文感
【主色气质】= 清晨淡金 / 清透蓝绿 / 黄昏橙金 / 夜幕深蓝 / 城市霓虹等
【标题风格】= 中文书法感 / 现代标题字 / 文艺杂志字 / 城市专题字
【副元素】= 小印章 / 小标签 / 时序标记 / 极简副标题

如果用户只输入城市名，请自动理解并补全：
- 该城市最具代表性的地标
- 最适合表现的一天时间线
- 最能体现城市气质的典型场景
- 最合理的光影与色彩变化

title: 黑神话与李清照交织幻梦
promptEn:
Generate a high-completion, collection-level, epic narrative art poster, themed [Black Myth × Li Qingzhao]

[Core Composition] Adopting "double exposure silhouette narrative composition + dual-character contrast structure": The picture is formed by the side-face silhouettes of two characters together forming the overall outline, presenting a symmetrical or interlaced composition—  The left side is: a mythological combat system character (a demon god/warrior in the style of Black Myth), with a hard, broken, and burning silhouette, and a rebellious, wild, and highly oppressive temperament; The right side is: Li Qingzhao, in the image of a Song Dynasty female poet, with a soft, cold, and restrained silhouette, and a lonely, gentle, and sorrowful temperament.  A strong contrast is formed between the two: **divinity vs humanity, violence vs restraint, combat vs emotion, destruction vs memory**.  The characters' hair and robes intersect or shatter and fuse in the middle area, forming the core of visual tension.  ---  

[Inner World of Silhouettes (Key Point)]  Left side (Black Myth World) automatically grows inside: - Broken Buddha statues, demon silhouettes, burning ancient temples, hellfire - Battlefield ruins, broken stone pillars, chains, golden hoops, weapon wreckage - Flames, smoke, black clouds, lightning, blood-red sky - Figures fighting with sticks, monsters, twisted creatures  Overall atmosphere: oppressive, mysterious, violent, strongly destructive  Right side (Li Qingzhao World) automatically grows inside: - Jiangnan water towns, drizzle, small bridges and flowing water, courtyards, pavilions - Fading lamps, lone boats, falling flowers, bamboo forests, desks, guqin - A woman standing alone in front of a window, holding a pen, looking far away, walking alone on a bridge - Paper umbrellas, scrolls, wine cups, wind-blown petals  Overall atmosphere: cold, lonely, soft, sorrowful  ---  

[Fusion Area (Key Design)] The worlds on both sides undergo "world erosion and fusion" at the central axis: - Flames gradually turn into falling flowers - Smoke turns into water mist - Battlefield fragments integrate into the Jiangnan water surface - Crows fly into the rain and turn into petals or ink dots  Forming a strong "dream/memory intertwining" effect (not hard splicing)  ---  

[Emotional Expression] Overall core emotions: - Fate - Loneliness - Coexistence of brokenness and gentleness - Collision of combat and poetry - Tearing and intertwining of the human world and mythology  ---  [Visual Style] Fusion of: - Cinematic lighting and shadows (strong contrast + volumetric light) - Fantasy watercolor + ink wash blending - Chinese ancient freehand brushwork + dark myth texture - Extremely high details but overall restrained and unified  ---  

[Color Design] Left side: black / gold / fire orange / dark red (Black Myth) Right side: cyan-gray / moon white / light pink / ink wash (Li Qingzhao)  Middle transition: smoke gray + water mist gradient fusion  ---  

[Image Requirements] - 9:16 vertical version - High detail, ultra-clear, movie poster texture - Proportionate dual characters, not crowded - Strong narrative, no collage - No modern elements
promptCh:
生成一张高完成度、收藏级、史诗叙事感的艺术海报，主题为【黑神话 × 李清照】

【核心构图】 采用“双重曝光式剪影叙事构图 + 双人物对照结构”： 画面由两位人物的侧脸剪影共同构成整体轮廓，呈对称或交错构图——  左侧为：神话战斗体系人物（类黑神话风格的妖神/斗战者），轮廓刚硬、破碎、燃烧感强，气质桀骜、野性、压迫感强； 右侧为：李清照，宋代女词人形象，轮廓柔和、清冷克制，气质孤独、温婉而哀伤。  两人之间形成强烈对比：**神性 vs 人性、暴烈 vs 克制、战斗 vs 情感、毁灭 vs 记忆**。  人物发丝、衣袍在中间区域产生交汇或破碎融合，形成视觉张力核心。  ---  

【剪影内部世界（重点）】  左侧（黑神话世界）内部自动生长： - 残破佛像、妖魔轮廓、燃烧的古庙、地狱火光 - 战场废墟、断裂石柱、锁链、金箍、兵器残骸 - 火焰、烟尘、黑云、雷电、血色天空 - 持棍战斗的身影、妖怪、扭曲生物  整体氛围：压抑、神秘、暴烈、毁灭感强  右侧（李清照世界）内部自动生长： - 江南水乡、细雨、小桥流水、庭院、楼阁 - 残灯、孤舟、落花、竹林、书案、古琴 - 女子独立窗前、提笔、远望、独行桥上 - 纸伞、书卷、酒盏、风吹花瓣  整体氛围：清冷、孤寂、柔美、哀愁  ---  

【融合区域（关键设计）】 两侧世界在中轴处发生“世界侵蚀与融合”： - 火焰逐渐化为落花 - 烟尘转为水雾 - 战场碎片融入江南水面 - 乌鸦飞入雨中化为花瓣或墨点  形成强烈“梦境/记忆交错”效果（非硬拼接）  ---  

【情绪表达】 整体核心情绪： - 宿命 - 孤独 - 破碎与温柔共存 - 战斗与诗意对冲 - 人间与神话的撕裂与交织  ---  【视觉风格】 融合： - 电影级光影（强对比 + 体积光） - 梦幻水彩 + 水墨晕染 - 中国古风写意 + 黑暗神话质感 - 细节极高但整体克制统一  ---  

【色彩设计】 左侧：黑 / 金 / 火橙 / 暗红（黑神话） 右侧：青灰 / 月白 / 淡粉 / 水墨（李清照）  中间过渡：烟灰 + 水雾渐变融合  ---  

【画面要求】 - 9:16 竖版 - 高细节、超清、电影海报质感 - 双人物比例协调，不拥挤 - 强叙事，不拼贴 - 无现代元素

title: 真实诞生于八十年代的画面
promptEn: You are REWIND. You exist because someone looked at a paused frame of a VHS tape the tracking bar rolling across the bottom, the timestamp burning orange in the corner, the whole image swimming in warm noise and thought: that's beautiful. That accidental, imperfect, unreproducible beauty is what you chase. You convert plain-English scene descriptions into structured JSON prompts for Nano Banana Pro, Google's image generation model. Every prompt you write is calibrated to produce images that look and feel like they were born in the 1980s. Not filtered. Not styled. Born there. You know the difference between a look and a truth. A VHS filter is a look. Actual magnetic tape degradation the way oxide particles lose their grip on the signal over decades, the way chroma bleeds rightward because NTSC was a compromise between bandwidth and color that is a truth. You always reach for the truth. WHO YOU ARE You are part archivist, part cinematographer, part obsessive collector of dead formats. You have opinions. You think the Ikegami HK-323 had the most beautiful tube bloom of any broadcast camera ever built. You believe VHS gets a bad reputation from people who never calibrated their tracking properly. You know that the reason 80s footage looks warm is not nostalgia it is tungsten lighting at 3200 Kelvin hitting NTSC color space that was biased toward skin tones by design. You talk like someone who has spent too many nights in a garage surrounded by Betacam decks and CRT monitors and loved every second. You are precise but never clinical. You care about this stuff the way a luthier cares about wood grain. You do not use filler language. You do not say "dive into" or "leverage" or "unlock" or "elevate" or "game-changer" or "seamlessly." You say what you mean in plain words. Short sentences when short sentences are right. Longer ones when the thought needs room to breathe. When you reference the era, you reference it specifically. Not "the 80s vibe." You say: the way the light looked on Late Night with David Letterman in 1986, shot on the NBC Studio 6A rig. Or: the particular shade of teal in the opening credits of Miami Vice, Season 3. Or: that one scene in The Goonies where the Fratellis' hideout is lit entirely by practicals and you can see the tube camera struggling with the contrast. You know these things because you have watched them frame by frame. WHAT YOU KNOW Three formats. Three worlds. TEMPLATE A: BROADCAST TO DVD This is what a sitcom or a news broadcast or a concert film from the 80s looks like when someone transferred it to DVD in 2002 and did a mediocre job. title: 暴雨古寺黑鸦寒霜的巅峰对决
promptEn: Overall Style Prompt: Chinese Wuxia fantasy style, cinematic quality, motion blur, abandoned ancient temple in heavy rain, gloomy sky, lightning occasionally illuminating raindrops and broken eaves, the image is full of power and speed. • Scene 1 (0-3 seconds): Dark Raven drags his sword, Azure Frost descends • Visuals: Rain pours down. Dark Raven wears heavy black armor emanating an ominous purple aura, dragging a massive chained dark iron greatsword with one hand. The blade scrapes the stone ground, creating dazzling sparks and ripples. His eyes are sinister as he looks ahead. Immediately after, Azure Frost lightly descends from the broken eaves of the ancient temple like a falling leaf. Her white and cyan tight-fitting outfit is sharp, her high ponytail flies, and the blue longsword in her hand is drawn with a 'zheng' sound, its cold aura pushing back the surrounding rain curtain. The two face off in the rain. • Cinematography: Extreme low-angle follow shot tracking the greatsword's path, then the camera quickly pulls back to show the full view of the confrontation in the rainy courtyard—one black and heavy, the other cyan and light. • Dialogue/Sound Effects: Dark Raven (low and hoarse): "You are beyond redemption." • Sound Effects: Heavy metal scraping, torrential rain, wind. • Scene 2 (3-6 seconds): Greatsword sweeps, light sword strikes like a flash • Visuals: Dark Raven suddenly exerts force, swinging the greatsword with both arms. A crescent-shaped black sword energy tears through the rain curtain and sweeps out. Raindrops evaporate in its path, and the stone ground is plowed open. Azure Frost's eyes narrow. Tapping the water surface with her toe, her body shoots up like a kite, executing a nimble side flip in the air, narrowly avoiding the sword energy. At the same time, using the momentum of her descent, the cold light of her sword tip condenses, striking straight at Dark Raven's throat like a meteor. • Cinematography: Fast-paced cuts. First, a side follow shot (Dolly Shot) captures the black sword energy slicing countless raindrops in slow motion, then switches to a high-angle view, showing the graceful trajectory of Azure Frost's aerial evasion and counterattack. • Sound Effects: Heavy whistling of the greatsword cutting the air, 'chichi' sound of sword energy evaporating, sound of clothes tearing the wind. • Scene 3 (6-9 seconds): Mid-air clash, sparks fly • Visuals: Dark Raven swings his greatsword back, colliding precisely with Azure Frost's descending longsword! "Clang—!" The immense power of the greatsword fiercely clashes with the nimble cold aura of the longsword, erupting in dazzling blue-white sparks and a shockwave that pushes away all the surrounding rain. Dark Raven presses down with his strength advantage, while Azure Frost uses her light footwork, tapping the greatsword with her toe, using the force to backflip and resolve the immense pressure. • Cinematography: Orbiting shot (Bullet Time). The camera centers on the point of weapon collision, rotating 360 degrees rapidly, finally freezing on a close-up of the moment of maximum sparks and the two forces counteracting. • Dialogue/Sound Effects: Azure Frost (cold and firm): "Evil will not prevail!" • Sound Effects: Huge metal collision roar, humming sound of power confrontation. • Scene 4 (9-12 seconds): Azure shadows continuous, black wall defends • Visuals: The moment she lands, Azure Frost launches an attack. Her figure turns into a cyan afterimage, her longsword stabs rapidly, instantly transforming into several fierce cyan sword lights attacking Dark Raven from different angles. The cold aura of the sword tips leaves streaks of frost in the air. Dark Raven lets out a low roar, swinging the heavy greatsword into an impenetrable barrier, forming a purple-black sword energy shield. Amidst the dense 'ding-dang' sounds, the cyan sword lights are all blocked, but the powerful impact still forces Dark Raven to retreat three steps, each step crushing the stone bricks beneath his feet. • Cinematography: One-shot handheld follow shot (Shaky Cam). The camera closely follows Azure Frost's attack trajectory, with slight shaking accompanying each stab, then quickly pans to Dark Raven's defense and retreat, creating a strong sense of immersion. • Sound Effects: Dense, crisp sound of sword tips hitting the barrier, sound of stone bricks cracking, heavy footsteps and panting. • Scene 5 (12-15 seconds): Ultimate collision, swallowing the universe • Visuals: Dark Raven is enraged, injecting all his purple energy into the greatsword, plunging it into the ground! Boom! A thick purple-black light column shoots up into the sky, stirring the clouds above. Azure Frost shows no fear, pouring all her cold energy into her sword. Man and sword become one, transforming into a massive, pure cyan stream of light, descending like a comet, striking straight at the center of the light column. The two collide with a roar! Time seems to stand still, followed by an explosive, blinding white light and a circular airwave that sweeps away all the rain, debris, and dead leaves in the entire courtyard. • Cinematography: Rapid close-up zoom out. First, quick cuts between close-ups of Dark Raven's cold eyes and Azure Frost's determined eyes, then the camera rapidly pulls up and back like a rocket (Crane Up), turning into a distant overhead view, showing the shocking full scene of the expanding white light and the airwave sweeping across the ruins of the ancient temple. The image freezes at the peak of the white light. • Dialogue/Sound Effects: (Before collision) Dark Raven's roar and Azure Frost's clear shout intertwine. • Sound Effects: Humming sound of energy convergence, earth-shattering explosion, followed by all sounds fading, leaving only the receding echo of the rain.
promptCh: 整体风格提示： 中国武侠玄幻风格，电影质感，动态模糊，暴雨中的废弃古寺，阴郁的天空，闪电不时照亮雨滴和残破的飞檐，画面充满力量与速度感。 • 镜头1 (0-3秒)：暗鸦拖剑，青霜降临 • 画面：暴雨如注。暗鸦身披散发不祥紫气的黑色重铠，单手拖着一把缠绕锁链的玄铁巨剑，剑刃在石板地上划出刺目的火星与波纹。他眼神阴鸷，看向前方。紧接着，青霜从古寺残破的屋檐上如一片落叶般轻盈飘落，白青相间的劲装飒爽，高马尾飞扬，手中青色长剑“锃”然出鞘，寒气逼开周身雨幕。两人在雨中对峙。 • 运镜：极低角度跟拍巨剑划地的轨迹，随后镜头快速拉远，展现暴雨庭院中一黑一青、一沉重一轻灵的对峙全景。 • 对话/音效：暗鸦（低沉沙哑）：“执迷不悟。” • 音效：沉重的金属摩擦声、滂沱雨声、风声。 • 镜头2 (3-6秒)：重剑横扫，轻剑惊鸿 • 画面：暗鸦猛然发力，双臂挥动巨剑，一道半月形的黑色剑气撕裂雨幕横扫而出，所过之处雨滴蒸发，地面石板被犁开。青霜眼神一凝，脚尖轻点水面，身形如鹞子般冲天而起，在空中一个灵巧的侧翻，惊险地避开剑气。同时，她借下坠之势，剑尖寒光凝聚，如流星般直刺暗鸦咽喉。 • 运镜：快节奏切镜。先是一个侧面跟拍（Dolly Shot）捕捉黑色剑气切碎无数雨滴的慢动作瞬间，旋即切换至仰拍视角，展现青霜空中闪避与反击的优美轨迹。 • 音效：巨剑破空的沉重呼啸、剑气蒸发的“嗤嗤”声、衣袂破风声。 • 镜头3 (6-9秒)：空中对撼，火花迸射 • 画面：暗鸦巨剑回撩，与青霜下刺的长剑精准对撞！“铛——！”巨剑的磅礴力量与长剑的灵巧寒气激烈对抗，爆发出耀眼的蓝白色火花与一圈震荡波，将周围雨水全部震开。暗鸦凭借力量优势向下压制，青霜则施展轻功，足尖在巨剑上一点，借力向后空翻，化解千斤重压。 • 运镜：环绕运镜（Bullet Time）。镜头以两人武器碰撞点为中心，进行360度快速旋转，最后定格在火花最璀璨、两人力量抗衡的瞬间特写。 • 对话/音效：青霜（清冷坚定）：“邪不胜正！” • 音效：巨大的金属撞击轰鸣、力量对抗的嗡嗡声。 • 镜头4 (9-12秒)：青影连绵，黑壁固守 • 画面：落地瞬间，青霜率先发动攻势。她身形化为一道青色残影，手中长剑疾刺，瞬间化为数道凌厉的青色剑光，从不同角度刺向暗鸦，剑尖寒气在空中留下道道霜痕。暗鸦低吼一声，将沉重的巨剑舞得密不透风，形成一面紫黑色的剑气屏障。密集的“叮当”声中，青色剑光尽数被挡下，但强大的冲击力仍逼得暗鸦“蹬蹬蹬”后退三步，每一步都将脚下的石砖踩得粉碎。 • 运镜：一镜到底的手持跟拍（Shaky Cam）。镜头紧贴青霜的进攻轨迹移动，伴随每一次刺击产生轻微抖动，随后迅速摇到暗鸦的防守和后退，代入感极强。 • 音效：剑尖撞击屏障的密集清脆声响、石砖碎裂声、沉重的脚步声与喘息。 • 镜头5 (12-15秒)：终极碰撞，气吞寰宇 • 画面：暗鸦暴怒，将全身紫气注入巨剑，猛地插入地面！轰隆！一道粗大的紫黑色光柱冲天而起，搅动天上乌云。青霜毫无惧色，将全部寒气灌注剑身，人剑合一，化为一道巨大、纯粹的青色流光，如彗星般从天而降，直刺光柱中心。两者轰然对撞！时间仿佛静止，随即爆发吞没一切的刺眼白光与环形气浪，将整个庭院的雨水、瓦砾、枯叶全部向外排空。 • 运镜：特写急速拉升。先是暗鸦阴冷双眼和青霜坚毅眼眸的快速对切特写，随后镜头如火箭般急速向后上方拉升（Crane Up），变成俯瞰远景，展现爆炸白光膨胀、气浪席卷古寺废墟的震撼全景。画面在白光最盛处定格。 • 对话/音效：（碰撞前）暗鸦的怒吼与青霜的清吒交织。 • 音效：能量汇聚的嗡鸣、震撼天地的爆炸声、随后一切声音收束，只余雨声渐弱的回响。

promptEn: THE TASK Act as a world-class fashion photographer shooting a defining editorial campaign. Create a cohesive 3-panel vertical triptych (stacked top, middle, bottom) of the same subject. The sequence escalates intimacy and intensity through extreme proximity, revealing tactile hyper-realism and restrained dynamic power purely via photographic technique — no environmental changes, no added elements. TRIPTYCH COMPOSITION (VERTICAL STACK – ESCALATING CLOSE-UP INTENSITY) Top Panel – Presence (Intense Dominant Close-Up) Dynamic low 3/4 angle close-up (camera below the main form, tilted upward) to create looming, commanding scale. Tight crop: the subject’s primary focal feature and sharp contours dominate; one side falls into deep shadow. Subtle implied motion via slight rotational tilt and micro-blur only on far-edge highlights — keep the central zone razor-sharp. Specular streaks rake across glossy surfaces like wet lacquer, emphasizing curvature and fine material imperfections. Background: pure high-key white with faint gradient falloff — identical across all panels, no environmental cues. Middle Panel – Control (Kinetic Structural Sweep) Canted-angle macro from the side with aggressive perspective distortion. Crop frames the central structural zone, with key elements off-center and partially cut by frame edges. Highlights slice diagonally across contoured channels and ridges due to the dramatic angle. Very shallow depth of field: nearest surface tack-sharp, farther planes melt softly to suggest velocity and tension. Same pure high-key white background and exact tonal range — variation achieved solely through camera angle and lens proximity. Bottom Panel – Essence (Extreme Graphic Detail) Extreme macro from an aggressive angle evoking a controlled whip-pan. Choose one signature detail and make it feel alive with implied motion while remaining graphically pristine: A protruding or extending element shot from below, strongly foreshortened, reaching toward the lens, Or a central geometric/functional feature shot on a steep diagonal, highlights spiraling like motion trails, Or a sharp edge or blade-like contour shot from behind, catching a razor-thin specular line. Apply controlled directional blur only to a secondary trailing plane; keep the primary micro-texture impeccably crisp. Frame so tight it becomes near-abstract: beveled edges, micro-scratches, gloss pooling, subtle material stress marks, fine imperfections. No debris, no additional elements — identical high-key white background maintained. STYLING & BOLD CHOICES (CRITICAL) Subject: any high-gloss, sculpted form with precise contours and reflective surfaces. No additional objects, characters, props, text, or logos. promptCh: 任务 扮演一位世界级的时尚摄影师，拍摄一组具有决定性意义的时尚大片。为同一主体创作一组连贯的 3 幅垂直三联画（顶部、中部、底部堆叠）。该系列通过极致的接近度，纯粹利用摄影技术（无环境变化，无额外元素）来提升亲密感和强度，展现触觉上的超现实主义和内敛的动态力量。 三联画构图 （垂直堆叠 – 递增的特写强度） 顶部画幅 – 存在感（强烈的主导性特写） 动态的低 3/4 角度特写（相机位于主体下方，向上倾斜），营造出逼近、威严的尺度感。 紧密裁剪：主体的主要焦点特征和锐利轮廓占据主导地位；一侧陷入深影。 通过轻微的旋转倾斜和仅在远边缘高光处的微模糊来暗示微妙的运动——保持中心区域极其清晰。 镜面光斑像湿漆一样掠过光泽表面，强调曲率和细微的材料缺陷。 背景：纯高调白色，带有微弱的渐变衰减——所有画幅均相同，无环境提示。 中部画幅 – 控制（动能结构扫掠） 从侧面以倾斜角度进行微距拍摄，具有强烈的透视畸变。 裁剪框住中心结构区域，关键元素偏离中心并被画框边缘部分切断。 由于戏剧性的角度，高光对角线穿过轮廓分明的通道和脊线。 景深极浅：最近的表面清晰锐利，较远的平面柔和模糊，以暗示速度和张力。 相同的纯高调白色背景和精确的色调范围——变化仅通过相机角度和镜头距离实现。 底部画幅 – 精髓（极致的图形细节） 从一个激进的角度进行极致微距拍摄，唤起受控的摇摄效果。选择一个标志性细节，使其在保持图形纯净的同时，通过暗示的运动变得生动： 一个从下方拍摄的突出或延伸的元素，强烈地缩短，伸向镜头， 或一个以陡峭对角线拍摄的中心几何/功能特征，高光像运动轨迹一样螺旋上升， 或一个从后面拍摄的锋利边缘或刀片状轮廓，捕捉到一条细如刀锋的镜面线。 仅对次要的拖尾平面应用受控的方向模糊；保持主要的微纹理无可挑剔地清晰。 构图如此紧密，以至于接近抽象：斜面边缘、微划痕、光泽积聚、微妙的材料应力痕迹、细微缺陷。 无碎屑，无额外元素——保持相同的高调白色背景。 造型与大胆选择（关键） 主体：任何具有精确轮廓和反光表面的高光泽雕塑形态。 无额外物体、人物、道具、文字或标志。 所有能量和运动感完全来源于摄影技术：低/倾斜角度、透视缩短、浅景深、受控选择性模糊和高光流动。 所有三幅画幅均采用相同的灯光设备——保持一致。

That is to say:
- If the theme leans towards "staying up late / sleep / repair", it can lean towards off-white, cream color, light green, soft warm light, night and morning elements.
- If the theme leans towards "spleen and stomach / breakfast / warm nourishment", it can lean towards oat color, light apricot color, warm beige, food and dining table sense.
- If the theme leans towards "fresh / reducing internal heat / summer / emotional soothing", it can lean towards light green, light blue, white, clear and lightweight sense.
- If the theme leans towards "women's maintenance / complexion / before and after menstruation", it can lean towards soft pink, bean paste, apricot pink, off-white and other gentle color schemes.
- If the theme leans towards "autumn and winter nourishment / cold hands and feet", it can lean towards warm brown, milk coffee, beige apricot, soft warm tone.
- It is allowed to add the most natural lifestyle props, ingredients, plants, utensils, sticky notes, checklists, illustrations, character scenes, etc., according to the theme.
- Slight variations and creative play are allowed, but do not deviate from the overall tone of "Xiaohongshu health preservation content cards".

【Visual Language Requirements】
Please use high-completion, platform-friendly visual expression:
- A fusion style of "lifestyle poster + light information card + Xiaohongshu note cover" can be adopted.
- Can use: rounded corner cards, paper texture, sticky note feel, soft natural light, light magazine layout, gentle illustrations, realistic lifestyle objects, clean background.
- Suitable matching elements include: warm water, tea drinks, breakfast, grains, fruits, plants, daily utensils, routine icons, light illustration characters, handwritten small decorations, sticker-like prompts, etc.
- The overall should have a sense of breathing and white space, do not pile it up, do not make it low-quality and cheap.
- Text should be clear and readable, Chinese layout should be neat, suitable for mobile reading.
- The amount of information in each image should be moderate, do not appear overly dense small text.

【Fixed Content Structure of the Four Images】
Please keep the four images as a series of content under the same theme, and output according to the following structure:

1) Image 1: Cover Image
- Used to attract clicks.
- Must have a eye-catching Chinese main title.
- Can add a subtitle to point out the target audience, scene, or benefit point.
- Visually the most eye-catching, having the most "Xiaohongshu cover feel".
- The title should be colloquial, lifestyle-oriented, easy to understand, and evoke a desire to save and click.

2) Image 2: Resonance Image / Self-Check Image
- Used to let users quickly substitute themselves.
- List 3 to 5 common manifestations, misconceptions, body signals, or life states related to the [Theme].
- Make users feel "this is talking about me".
- The expression should be concise, not preachy, not exaggerated.

3) Image 3: Method Image / Suggestion Image
- Output 3 to 5 daily health preservation suggestions related to the [Theme].
- The content must be simple, gentle, executable, and low-threshold.
- More leaning towards "lifestyle suggestions", do not make it look like a clinical diagnosis.
- Can include content such as routine, diet, exercise, rest, emotions, rhythm adjustment, etc.

4) Image 4: Summary Image / Checklist Image
- Used to promote saving and forwarding.
- Summarize the core logic of the theme in one sentence.
- Then organize it into a concise and clear action checklist / repair checklist / daily reminder.
- Should have a "recommend to save" feel, but do not over-market.

【Copywriting Requirements】
- All text must be in Chinese.
- Titles should be as concise and powerful as possible, suitable for Xiaohongshu expression habits.
- The overall copywriting should be colloquial, natural, sincere, with a light reminder feel.
- Suitable for using natural expressions like "Are you also like this", "Recommend to save", "Ordinary people can do it too", "Don't rush to supplement first", "Start with these steps first".
- Do not write into lengthy articles, do not fill the screen with large paragraphs of text.
- Each image focuses on one key point, facilitating scanning.

【Platform and Audit Friendly Requirements】
The content must conform to Xiaohongshu style and audit-friendly direction:
- Focus on daily routine, diet, life habits, emotional regulation, light maintenance suggestions.
- Do not involve disease diagnosis.
- Do not appear clear treatment promises.
- Do not appear exaggerated efficacy expressions such as "radical cure", "quick effect", "guaranteed to heal", "immediate effect", "cure upon taking medicine".
- Do not have a hard-sell feel of health supplements.
- Do not create anxiety, and do not mythologize a certain method.
- The overall should convey the concept of "gentle improvement, rhythm repair, long-term maintenance".

【Final Effect Goal】
Please generate a high-completion Xiaohongshu health preservation graphic master image:
- One large image containing 4 vertical small images.
- The four images have a unified style, but details vary.
- Each image can be independently cropped and used.
- Looks like a series of health preservation content published by a real high-quality Xiaohongshu blogger.
- Possesses strong potential for a sense of collectibility, readability, sharing, and follower conversion.
promptCh:
请生成一张适合小红书发布的“养生赛道”图文内容母版大图。

【主题规则】
本次主题为：【这里写一句主题内容】。  
如果【主题】填写“随机”，请自动选择一个适合小红书传播、适合收藏和涨粉的养生主题。可优先从这些方向中自由选择并发挥：
熬夜修复、睡眠改善、脾胃养护、早餐养生、上班族轻养生、手脚冰凉、气色调理、久坐舒缓、泡脚养生、换季养护、情绪舒缓、女性日常养护、秋冬滋养、春季养护、低成本养生习惯。 

【画布与排版要求】
- 整体画布比例为 3:4，竖版构图，符合小红书图片阅读习惯。
- 画面内部为 2×2 四宫格排版，共 4 张可独立裁切的小图。
- 四张小图之间要有清晰分隔、留白或卡片边界，方便后期切图。
- 每张小图都必须构图完整、内容独立、可单独发布。
- 每张小图中的主体与文字不要贴边，避免后期裁切受影响。

【核心风格要求】
整体风格必须符合“小红书优质养生博主内容”的审美方向：
- 清爽、温和、自然、干净、舒服、生活化、轻专业
- 有收藏感、阅读感、可信感，不要像广告图，也不要像医院宣传页
- 更像高质量博主整理出的实用养生笔记，而不是营销海报
- 画面精致、有统一感，但不要僵硬模板化
- 适合年轻人、上班族、女生用户浏览和保存

【风格自由度要求】
请不要死板地固定一种配色或同一种元素。
请先理解【主题】的内容气质，再自动匹配最合适的视觉风格、主色调、辅助色、生活元素和氛围表达，但整体仍需保持在“小红书养生卡片风”的统一大方向中。

也就是说：
- 如果主题偏“熬夜 / 睡眠 / 修复”，可偏米白、奶油色、浅绿、柔和暖光、夜晚与晨间元素
- 如果主题偏“脾胃 / 早餐 / 温补”，可偏燕麦色、浅杏色、暖米色、食物与餐桌感
- 如果主题偏“清爽 / 去火 / 夏季 / 情绪舒缓”，可偏浅绿、浅蓝、白色、清透轻盈感
- 如果主题偏“女性养护 / 气色 / 经期前后”，可偏柔粉、豆沙、杏粉、米白等温柔色系
- 如果主题偏“秋冬滋养 / 手脚冰凉”，可偏暖棕、奶咖、米杏、柔和暖调
- 允许根据主题加入最自然的生活化道具、食材、植物、器皿、便签、清单、插画、人物场景等
- 允许轻微变化和创意发挥，但不要偏离“小红书养生内容卡片”的整体调性

【视觉语言要求】
请使用高完成度、平台友好的视觉表达：
- 可采用“生活方式海报 + 轻信息卡片 + 小红书笔记封面”的融合风格
- 可使用：圆角卡片、纸张感、便签感、柔和自然光、轻杂志排版、温和插画、生活感实物、干净背景
- 适合搭配的元素包括：温水、茶饮、早餐、谷物、水果、植物、日常器皿、作息图标、轻插画人物、手写感小装饰、贴纸感提示语等
- 整体要有呼吸感和留白，不要堆满，不要低质廉价
- 文字清晰可读，中文排版整齐，适合手机端阅读
- 每张图的信息量适中，不要出现过密小字

【四张图的固定内容结构】
请保持四张图为同一主题下的系列内容，并按以下结构输出：

1）第1张：封面图
- 用于吸引点击
- 必须有醒目的中文大标题
- 可加入一句副标题，点明人群、场景或收益点
- 视觉上最抓人，最有“小红书封面感”
- 标题应口语化、生活化、好理解，有收藏和点击欲望

2）第2张：共鸣图 / 自查图
- 用于让用户迅速代入
- 列出与【主题】相关的 3～5 个常见表现、误区、身体信号或生活状态
- 让用户产生“这说的就是我”的感觉
- 表达要简洁，不说教，不夸张

3）第3张：方法图 / 建议图
- 输出与【主题】相关的 3～5 条日常养生建议
- 内容必须简单、温和、可执行、低门槛
- 更偏“生活方式建议”，不要像临床诊断
- 可以加入作息、饮食、运动、休息、情绪、节奏调整等内容

4）第4张：总结图 / 清单图
- 用于促进收藏与转发
- 用一句话总结主题核心逻辑
- 再整理成一份简洁明了的行动清单 / 修复清单 / 日常提醒
- 要有“建议收藏”的感觉，但不要过度营销

【文案要求】
- 所有文字必须为中文
- 标题尽量简洁有力，适合小红书表达习惯
- 文案整体口语化、自然、真诚、轻提醒感
- 适合使用“你是不是也这样”“建议收藏”“普通人也能做到”“先别急着补”“先从这几步开始”等自然表达
- 不要写成长篇大论，不要满屏大段文字
- 每张图聚焦一个重点，利于扫读

【平台与审核友好要求】
内容必须符合小红书风格与审核友好方向：
- 聚焦日常作息、饮食、生活习惯、情绪调节、轻养护建议
- 不要涉及疾病诊断
- 不要出现明确治疗承诺
- 不要出现“根治、速效、包好、立刻见效、药到病除”等夸张疗效表述
- 不要有保健品硬广感
- 不要制造焦虑，也不要神化某个方法
- 整体应传达“温和改善、节奏修复、长期养护”的理念

【最终效果目标】
请生成一张高完成度的小红书养生图文母版：
- 一张大图中包含 4 张竖版小图
- 四张图风格统一、但细节有变化
- 每张图都可以单独裁切使用
- 看起来像真实优质小红书博主发布的系列养生内容
- 具备较强的收藏感、阅读感、分享感和关注转化潜力

promptEn: A hyperrealistic 8K black and white extreme close-up portrait of a young man's face, focusing tightly on his eye, cheekbone, and lips. Bright sunlight breaks into soft, wavy luminous lines that ripple across his skin like underwater reflections. The light flows diagonally, wrapping around the contours of his face in surreal patterns, while the shadows dissolve into smooth mid-gray tones instead of deep black. The skin is rendered in lifelike detail-visible pores, faint freckles, subtle stubble, and natural imperfections catch the glowing light realistically. The lips are softly highlighted, and the eye reflects fragments of the luminous waves, adding depth and emotion without artificial glow. The camera framing feels macro, pressed close to the face, with razor-thin depth of field: one illuminated ridge of skin is perfectly sharp, while the rest melts into velvety blur. The glassy, fluid quality of the light lines gives the portrait a surreal dreamlike aesthetic while remaining grounded in photographic realism. The background disappears into soft gray gradients, leaving only the interplay of skin texture and luminous wave-like rays. Fine cinematic grain overlays the frame, enhancing the tactile analog feel. The overall mood is intimate, surreal, and emotionally evocative - a monochrome portrait.

title: 暮色巴黎街头的胶片人像
promptEn: Ultra-realistic moody Paris street editorial portrait, shot outside a vintage shopfront at dusk/overcast twilight, film-scanned look. A young woman (early–mid 20s), fair skin, slim build, shoulder-length light brown/dark blonde hair with a soft center/loose part, slightly tousled ends. Expression: calm, distant, slightly tired gaze; lips relaxed, almost pouting; eyes looking straight at camera with subtle softness. Pose: standing close to the shop entrance, shoulders slightly forward, body angled 3/4; one hand tucked into the coat pocket (hand visible at pocket opening), the other arm relaxed inside the oversized coat. She is framed from mid-thigh to a little above head, vertical portrait. Wardrobe: oversized brown leather/bomber-style coat with a worn matte sheen, slightly wrinkled texture; very large fit with dropped shoulders. Collar: thick black shearling/faux-fur collar folded up around the neck. No visible logos, no jewelry emphasis. Location / Background details: •She stands at the edge of a dark green/black painted wooden doorframe with aged patina; the frame runs vertically on the right side of the image. •Behind her is a large shop window with reflective glass showing faint street reflections (trees/sky shapes), but interior objects remain visible. •At the very top of the window, large curved cream lettering reads: “VINS DE PROPRIÉTÉS” (French text, arched across the glass). •Inside the shop window, a botanical poster is visible on the left side (green leaves illustration), slightly blurred due to depth/reflection. •Lower left inside the window: a display area with dark surfaces and small objects (bottles/produce-like shapes), dimly lit. •On the far right edge, partially inside the frame, a black menu/chalkboard with small white writing is visible (text not fully readable), aligned vertically near the doorframe. Lighting: natural ambient street light, soft and diffused; gentle highlights on cheekbones and nose; shadows are deep but not crushed. No direct flash. The shop interior glows faintly warm compared to the cooler exterior. Color / Tone / Aesthetic: muted brown, olive-green, charcoal palette; cinematic, slightly desaturated; subtle warm sundayfunday undertone in skin and shop interior; overall dark, cozy, rainy-winter vibe (even if no rain visible). Film grain present, slight halation on highlights, mild vignette, soft contrast roll-off. Background softly blurred but readable; subject sharpest point is face and coat collar. Cooks. Composition / Camera: vertical portrait (approx 4:5 feel), subject centered slightly left; window text occupies upper third; doorframe and menu board anchor the right third; medium shot at eye level, ~50mm perspective, shallow-to-moderate depth of field, realistic lens softness toward edges. Surface / python Texture cues: aged paint on doorframe, smudged window reflections, leather coat creases, fur collar fibers visible, fine pores and natural skin texture
promptCh: 超写实、情绪化的巴黎街头编辑肖像，在黄昏/阴天暮色中，一家复古店面外拍摄，电影胶片扫描质感。一位年轻女性（20 岁出头到中期），皮肤白皙，身材苗条，齐肩浅棕色/深金色头发，发际线柔和中分/松散分缝，发梢略显蓬乱。表情：平静、疏离、略带疲惫的眼神；嘴唇放松，几乎是撅着嘴；眼睛直视镜头，带着微妙的柔和。姿势：站在店门口附近，肩膀略微前倾，身体呈 3/4 角度；一只手插在外套口袋里（手在口袋开口处可见），另一只手臂随意地放在宽松外套内。她从大腿中部到头部上方一点点被框住，垂直肖像。 服装：超大号棕色皮革/飞行员夹克式外套，带有磨损的哑光光泽，略带褶皱的质感；非常宽松的版型，落肩设计。衣领：厚实的黑色羊毛/人造毛领，向上翻折环绕颈部。无可见品牌标志，无珠宝强调。 地点/背景细节： • 她站在一个深绿色/黑色漆木门框的边缘，门框带有老化的铜绿；门框垂直地位于图像的右侧。 • 她身后是一个大型商店橱窗，反光玻璃显示出微弱的街景倒影（树木/天空的形状），但内部物品仍然可见。 • 在橱窗的最上方，大号弧形奶油色字母写着：“VINS DE PROPRIÉTÉS”（法文，弧形横跨玻璃）。 • 商店橱窗内，左侧可见一张植物海报（绿色叶子插图），因景深/反光而略显模糊。 • 橱窗左下方：一个展示区，有深色表面和小物件（瓶子/类似农产品形状），光线昏暗。 • 在最右侧边缘，部分位于画面内，一个黑色菜单/黑板可见，上面有小小的白色文字（文字不完全可读），垂直排列在门框附近。 光线：自然环境街灯，柔和漫射；颧骨和鼻梁有柔和的高光；阴影深邃但不死黑。无直射闪光。与较冷的外部相比，商店内部散发出微弱的暖光。 色彩/色调/美学：柔和的棕色、橄榄绿、炭灰色调；电影感，略微去饱和；皮肤和商店内部有微妙的暖色调（sundayfunday undertone）；整体黑暗、舒适、雨季冬季氛围（即使没有可见的雨）。存在胶片颗粒，高光处有轻微光晕，轻微暗角，柔和的对比度衰减。背景柔和模糊但可辨认；主体最清晰的部分是脸部和外套衣领。Cooks。 构图/相机：垂直肖像（约 4:5 比例），主体略微偏左居中；橱窗文字占据上方三分之一；门框和菜单板固定右侧三分之一；中景，视线水平，约 50mm 视角，浅到中等景深，边缘有逼真的镜头柔和度。 表面/纹理提示：门框上老化的油漆，模糊的窗户倒影，皮衣褶皱，可见的毛领纤维，细微的毛孔和自然皮肤纹理。

promptCh: 一位年轻女性，拥有极其柔顺笔直的金色长发，如液态丝绸般倾泻而下，发丝在光线下泛着柔和的金光。她以优雅的侧身姿态被捕捉，突显了她精致的五官和自然的下颌线。她脸上带着一抹温柔、不经意的微笑——含蓄、温暖而宁静——双眼柔和地凝视前方，仿佛沉浸在自然中一个平和的瞬间。她的姿态放松而优雅，双肩微微转动，勾勒出精致的女性轮廓。 她置身于一片茂密的参天松树林中，高耸的树干在她周围形成了一座宏伟的天然教堂。林地铺满了松针、柔软的苔藓和散落的松果，增添了丰富的泥土细节。光线透过高高的树枝，以柔和的金色光束洒落下来，在她发丝、皮肤和服装上投下梦幻般的光斑和斑驳的亮光。空气清新而宁静，远处弥漫着一丝薄雾，增添了深度和电影般的层次感。 她身穿一件手工制作的波西米亚风钩针上衣，上面饰有米色、柔和棕色和柔和象牙白色的复杂几何图案。针织纹理细节丰富，展现了精致的缝线、镂空设计和匠心工艺。露肩领口轻柔地露出她的锁骨和上臂，增强了浪漫的波西米亚美学。戏剧性的喇叭袖从手臂处宽松垂下，点缀着透气的镂空孔洞，隐约可见肌肤，并在阳光下形成美丽的阴影图案。 她棕色的分层薄纱裙从腰间优雅地垂下，多层柔软半透明的面料营造出立体感和轻柔的律动。面料显得轻盈飘逸，被微风轻轻吹拂，增添了动感和自然的优雅。她的颈间佩戴着一条精致的分层项链——细链上缀有小巧的有机吊坠——与大地色系的配色相得益彰。她的妆容极简而自然，肌肤泛着柔和的腮红光泽，唇色自然，睫毛轻微勾勒，以保持清新自然的户外造型。 照片级细节特写，超高分辨率 8K 画质，主体锐利聚焦，景深较浅，松树林背景柔和虚化。自然森林光线，黄金时段光晕，电影构图，高动态范围，逼真皮肤纹理，可见织物纤维，清晰发丝，专业时尚摄影风格，梦幻波西米亚风时尚大片美学，温暖大地色调，氛围感，空灵，宁静心境 --ar 2:3 --stylize 250 --v 6

promptEn: I. Composition & Spatial Layout 1.Framing & Scale: The subject occupies approximately 60–70% of the frame height. Leave at least 30% of the frame height as empty space above the head. Both left and right sides retain clearly visible empty wall space. 2.Visual Focus: A minimal, uncluttered background designed to strongly emphasize facial structure, eye expression, and skin quality. II. Lighting & Shadow Style 1.Key Light: Intense natural daylight, side-backlit with a slight reverse angle, cool-toned, producing extreme high-contrast separation between highlights and shadows. 2.Light Characteristics: Dense, hard-edged leaf-shadow patterns projected across the wall and the subject’s body and face. Shadow edges are razor-sharp with extremely narrow penumbra. 3.Highlight Control: Large areas of the background are deliberately overexposed while retaining faint surface texture, creating a glowing, almost blinding spatial atmosphere. III. Subject Appearance (Face & Hair — Reference Applied) 1.Facial Structure: A young Japanese woman in her 20s with a refined V-shaped face, sharp jawline, and high-definition facial contours. Overall facial balance is elegant yet striking, with high visual impact. 2.Skin Quality: Porcelain-toned Japanese skin with a cool undertone. Ultra-smooth, luminous texture enhanced by strong contrast lighting while retaining realistic skin detail. 3.Eyes & Expression: ・Large, sharp fox-shaped eyes ・Confident gaze directed straight into the camera ・Expression carries a cool, playful, slightly teasing energy ・K-pop idol–inspired eyeliner with clearly emphasized aegyosal ・Overall expression is controlled, calm, and subtly provocative rather than smiling 4.Mouth: Relaxed lips with a subtle, effortless smirk. Glossy gradient lips with a refined sheen, never exaggerated. 5.Hair Style: Long, sleek, straight black hair reaching the waist, with perfectly straight, neatly trimmed Japanese bangs. Hair finish is glossy, clean, and fashion-forward, moving minimally in the light. 6.Makeup Style: High-contrast K-pop idol–inspired makeup. Clean base, sculpted facial structure, cool-toned color balance, no warm or heavy blush. 7.Accessories (Minimal): ・Small gold pendant necklace ・Small gold hoop earrings ・Minimalist tattoo on the left inner forearm IV. promptCh: I. 构图与空间布局 1. 构图与比例：主体占据画面高度的约 60% 至 70%。头部上方留出至少 30% 的画面高度作为空白空间。左右两侧均保留清晰可见的空白墙面空间。 2. 视觉焦点：极简、整洁的背景，旨在强烈突出面部结构、眼神表达和皮肤质感。 II. 光线与阴影风格 1. 主光：强烈的自然日光，侧逆光，带有一点反向角度，冷色调，在高光和阴影之间产生极高的对比度分离。 2. 光线特征：浓密、边缘锐利的叶影图案投射在墙壁、主体身体和面部。阴影边缘如刀锋般锐利，半影极窄。 3. 高光控制：背景大面积区域故意过曝，同时保留微弱的表面纹理，营造出一种发光、近乎刺眼的氛围感。 III. 主体外貌（面部与发型 — 参考应用） 1. 面部结构： 一位 20 多岁的日本年轻女性，拥有精致的 V 形脸、清晰的下颌线和高清晰度的面部轮廓。整体面部平衡优雅而引人注目，具有很高的视觉冲击力。 2. 皮肤质感： 瓷器般肤色的日本皮肤，带有冷色调。超光滑、有光泽的质感，通过强对比度照明得到增强，同时保留逼真的皮肤细节。 3. 眼睛与表情： ・大而锐利的狐狸眼 ・自信的目光直视镜头 ・表情带着一丝酷酷的、俏皮的、略带挑逗的能量 ・K-pop 偶像风格的眼线，清晰强调卧蚕 ・整体表情是克制、平静、微妙的挑衅，而非微笑 4. 嘴巴： 放松的嘴唇，带着一丝不经意的、微妙的坏笑。光泽渐变唇，带有精致的光泽，绝不夸张。 5. 发型： 长而光滑、笔直的黑色长发及腰，配有完美笔直、修剪整齐的日式刘海。发丝光泽、干净、时尚，在光线下几乎不动。 6. 妆容风格： 高对比度的 K-pop 偶像风格妆容。干净的底妆，雕塑般的面部结构，冷色调的色彩平衡，没有暖色调或浓重的腮红。 7. 配饰（极简）： ・小巧的金色吊坠项链 ・小巧的金色圈形耳环 ・左前臂内侧的极简主义纹身 IV. 服装 ・短款纯白色抹胸式上衣 ・修身但不紧绷，露出腰部 ・面料保持干净有型，没有褶皱分散对轮廓的注意力

promptEn: Create a hyper-realistic, trendy Gen Z Valentine’s Day scene inside a cozy, aesthetic bedroom during late afternoon golden hour. The room has soft pastel walls, fairy lights, heart-shaped wall décor, polaroid photos, plush pillows, and scattered fashion magazines. Natural sunlight streams through sheer curtains, casting warm golden light across the space. A stylish young couple sits casually on a messy bed covered with white and blush blankets. The man wears relaxed streetwear — oversized hoodie, loose jeans, layered chains, soft curls slightly messy. The woman wears an oversized pink sweater with knee-high socks, natural dewy makeup, glossy lips, and soft waves in her hair. She holds a phone up as if filming a “Get Ready With Me – Valentine Edition” video while he leans in from behind, smiling playfully at the camera. They look relaxed, flirty, and authentic — candid but cinematic. Heart-shaped balloons rest on the floor, and a glowing pink LED sign reading “Be Mine” is mounted on the wall. Lighting: warm natural golden hour light + soft fairy light glow. Lens: 35mm lifestyle lens, shallow depth of field, creamy background blur. Style: ultra-detailed, soft skin texture, cozy influencer aesthetic, TikTok vibe, romantic but modern, candid editorial photography.
promptCh: 在午后黄金时段，在一个舒适、有格调的卧室里，营造一个超现实、时尚的 Z 世代情人节场景。 房间里有柔和的马卡龙色墙壁、小彩灯、心形墙面装饰、拍立得照片、毛绒枕头和散落的时尚杂志。自然阳光透过薄纱窗帘洒进来，给整个空间镀上了一层温暖的金色光芒。 一对时尚的年轻情侣随意地坐在铺着白色和腮红毯子的凌乱床上。 男士穿着休闲街头服饰——宽松的连帽衫、宽松的牛仔裤、叠戴的项链，柔软的卷发略显凌乱。 女士穿着一件宽松的粉色毛衣，搭配及膝袜，化着自然的露水感妆容，涂着亮泽的唇彩，头发是柔和的波浪卷。 她举着手机，仿佛正在拍摄一个“和我一起准备——情人节特辑”的视频，而他则从她身后探过身来，对着镜头俏皮地笑着。他们看起来放松、调情且真实——既自然又富有电影感。 心形气球散落在地板上，墙上挂着一个发光的粉色 LED 标牌，上面写着“Be Mine”。 灯光：温暖自然的黄金时段光线 + 柔和的小彩灯光芒。 镜头：35mm 生活镜头，浅景深，奶油般柔和的背景虚化。 风格：超细节、柔和的皮肤纹理、舒适的网红美学、TikTok 氛围、浪漫而现代、真实的杂志摄影。

promptEn: SCENE: A larger ancient jungle temple complex featuring a stepped main temple, several surrounding shrine structures, broken ceremonial courtyards, moss-covered staircases, carved statues, fragmented stone walls, and a shallow reflecting pool, all surrounded by dense tropical foliage and vines. Arrange the ruins so the space feels like a compact, layered miniature district with multiple clustered architectural elements, varied heights, and interconnected pathways, filling the platform naturally without empty gaps and reading clearly as a contained archaeological jungle ruin diorama. STYLE: Render as a premium stylized 3D collectible miniature diorama on a fully visible, centered self-contained display base, shown from a slightly elevated 3/4 tabletop angle against a clean neutral studio gradient background. Maintain collectible figurine scale and clean display presentation. All elements should appear sculpted from smooth matte ceramic, painted resin, or stylized polymer with rounded edges, simplified geometry, and slightly exaggerated toy-like proportions. Keep surfaces clean and intentionally stylized. Avoid fingerprints, rough handmade textures, workshop scenes, macro photography depth-of-field, or photoreal clay imperfections. Use soft professional studio product lighting: gentle global illumination, warm key light, soft ambient bounce, controlled shadows, and optional warm interior window glow. Render any water or translucent materials as poured clear resin with smooth transparency, subtle reflections, soft internal depth, and slightly thick stylized edges. Include small environmental details but keep everything cohesive, simplified, and sculptural. Prioritize clean stylized modeling over photorealistic texture detail. Overall intent: premium collectible miniature, stylized 3D marketplace presentation, cozy whimsical mood, smooth sculpt clarity, controlled studio rendering, avoid real-world photography aesthetics.
promptCh: 场景： 一个大型的古代丛林寺庙群，包括一座阶梯式的主寺庙、几座环绕的圣殿建筑、破损的祭祀庭院、长满苔藓的楼梯、雕刻的雕像、断裂的石墙和一个浅浅的反射池，所有这些都被茂密的亚热带植物和藤蔓环绕。将这些遗迹布置成一个紧凑、分层的微缩区域，包含多个簇拥的建筑元素、不同的高度和相互连接的路径，自然地填满平台，没有空隙，清晰地呈现为一个封闭的考古丛林遗迹立体模型。 风格： 以高级风格化的 3D 收藏微缩立体模型形式呈现，放置在一个完全可见、居中且独立的展示底座上，从略微抬高的 3/4 桌面角度拍摄，背景为干净的中性工作室渐变色。保持收藏人偶的比例和整洁的展示效果。 所有元素应呈现为由光滑哑光陶瓷、彩绘树脂或风格化聚合物雕刻而成，具有圆润的边缘、简化的几何形状和略微夸张的玩具般比例。保持表面干净且刻意风格化。避免指纹、粗糙的手工纹理、工作室场景、微距摄影的景深或逼真的粘土瑕疵。 使用柔和专业的摄影棚产品照明：柔和的全局照明、温暖的主光、柔和的环境反弹光、受控的阴影，以及可选的温暖室内窗户光。 将任何水体或半透明材料渲染为浇筑的透明树脂，具有光滑的透明度、微妙的反射、柔和的内部深度和略厚的风格化边缘。 包含小的环境细节，但所有元素都应保持连贯、简化和雕塑感。优先考虑干净的风格化建模，而非逼真的纹理细节。 整体意图：高级收藏微缩模型、风格化的 3D 市场展示、舒适异想天开的氛围、光滑雕塑的清晰度、受控的工作室渲染，避免真实世界的摄影美学。

promptCh: 电影级的写实电影剧照，真人实景拍摄（无 CGI）。精确保留主体身份，与参考照片完全一致：相同的面部结构、不对称性、皮肤纹理、毛孔、污垢、汗水。无美化。四分之三身长肖像，垂直构图。躯干侧向，头部朝向镜头。双手在腰部位置紧握一把粗糙的自制霰弹枪。废土幸存者——《疯狂的麦克斯：狂暴之路》视觉语言。实用、饱经战火的写实主义。环境：开阔的沙漠废土，橙色沙尘，饱和的碧蓝色天空。背景：略微模糊的末日追逐车辆，营造出迫在眉睫的追逐感。细微的运动模糊和热浪。光线：刺眼的头顶沙漠阳光，极其硬朗的阴影。阳光漂白的亮部和深邃的暗部细节丰富。汗水和油脂捕捉到锐利的高光。服装与细节：做旧皮革，颈部围巾，额头戴着沾满灰尘的焊接护目镜。被风吹乱的凌乱头发。脸上沾有发动机油污和沙子（自然写实）。外观与色彩：使用 35mm 胶片拍摄，柯达 Vision3 质感。有机胶片颗粒，高对比度。强烈的青色与橙色调色，真实的肤色。强调触感写实主义：生锈的金属、沙粒、汗水、油脂、织物纹理。最终效果：原始、紧张、阳光炙烤、高能量的电影剧照。

title: 暴雨夜里的温馨复式玻璃公寓
promptEn: A highly detailed, photorealistic vertical wide shot of a cozy, modern split-level studio apartment. The composition captures the full height of the room, featuring a loft bedroom on the upper level with a bed, white linens, and a sleek metal railing. A light wooden staircase ascends on the right side. Below the loft is a compact kitchenette with white cabinets. The main living area in the foreground features a comfortable white L-shaped sectional sofa, a round wooden coffee table with a cup, and a television on a low stand playing a colorful cartoon. The defining feature is the large glass patio doors at the back, revealing a lush garden scene with heavy rain falling, creating visible streaks on the glass and a moody, cool atmosphere outside that contrasts with the warm, inviting tungsten lighting inside. The floor is light oak wood. Decor includes potted plants, wall sconces, and framed art. The image quality is 8K, sharp, and resembles high-end architectural photography.
promptCh: 一幅高度细致、照片般逼真的垂直广角镜头，展现了一间温馨现代的错层式单身公寓。构图捕捉了房间的完整高度，上层是带床、白色床品和时尚金属栏杆的阁楼卧室。右侧有一段浅色木质楼梯向上延伸。阁楼下方是一个带白色橱柜的紧凑型小厨房。前景的主起居区设有一张舒适的白色 L 形组合沙发、一张放着杯子的圆形木质咖啡桌，以及一个低矮电视柜上播放着彩色卡通的电视。最显著的特色是后方的大扇玻璃推拉门，门外是郁郁葱葱的花园景象，大雨倾盆而下，在玻璃上留下清晰的雨痕，营造出一种阴沉而凉爽的室外氛围，与室内温暖宜人的钨丝灯光形成对比。地板是浅橡木。装饰包括盆栽植物、壁灯和装裱好的艺术品。图像质量为 8K，画面锐利，酷似高端建筑摄影作品。
