title: 麦昆奢华球鞋九宫格商业摄影大片
promptEn: Create a 3x3 grid for a high-end commercial marketing campaign, centered around Alexander McQueen men's luxury sneakers. Each frame should present a unique visual concept while maintaining perfect product consistency across all nine images. Grid Concepts (one per cell): 1. 'Iconic Hero Shot': Eye-level side view on a dark, glossy pedestal, emphasizing the signature oversized sole. 2. 'Extreme Macro Detail': Close-up of the heel or stitching, highlighting the top-tier leather texture and the 'Alexander McQueen' logo embossing. 3. 'Dynamic Interaction': The shoe stepping onto a surface, creating a subtle and elegant splash effect of black liquid or marble powder. 4. 'Minimalist Sculptural Feel': The shoe artistically balanced on a geometric concrete or marble block, emphasizing the architectural design. 5. 'Floating Lightness': The shoe suspended in the air with dynamic hanging laces, conveying supreme comfort and lightness. 6. 'Sensory Texture': A tactile atmosphere shot focusing on the contrast between the velvet or smooth leather upper and a rough stone texture. 7. 'Monochromatic Luxury': A color-block scene where the background perfectly matches the shoe's accent color, creating a bold editorial look. 8. 'Deconstructed Craftsmanship': An abstract arrangement of raw materials (leather swatches, rubber textures) surrounding the shoe, symbolizing high-quality construction. 9. 'Surreal Fusion': The shoe integrated into a surreal, dreamlike landscape, blending realism with high fashion. Visual Rules: * 'Subject': Alexander McQueen men's oversized sneakers. * 'Consistency': The shoe's shape, proportion, sole thickness, logo placement, and typography must be 100% accurate. * 'No Distortion': No deformation of the signature sole or branding. * 'Separation': Clear separation between the shoe and the background. Lighting and Style: * Soft, controlled studio lighting with dramatic rim light to highlight the shoe's silhouette. * Subtle highlights on the leather, deep realistic shadows under the sole. * High dynamic range, 8K resolution, ultra-sharp focus. * Editorial luxury fashion advertising aesthetic (Vogue/GQ style). * Color Palette: Minimalist, monochromatic, metallic, and deep matte tones. Overall Vibe: * Modern, sophisticated, visually coherent. * High-end commercial campaign for a luxury fashion brand. * Surreal, cinematic, refined, and aspirational.
promptCh: 为高端商业营销活动创建3×3网格，以Alexander McQueen男士奢侈运动鞋为中心主题。 每帧展现独特视觉概念，同时保持九张图像中完美的产品一致性。 网格概念（每格一个）： 1. '标志性英雄镜头'：深色光滑基座上的眼平面侧视图，强调标志性超大鞋底。 2. '极致微距细节'：鞋跟或缝线特写，突显顶级皮革纹理和'Alexander McQueen'标志压纹。 3. '动态交互'：鞋踏上表面产生微妙优雅的黑色液体或大理石粉溅洒效果。 4. '极简雕塑感'：鞋艺术性地平衡在几何混凝土或大理石块上，强调建筑设计。 5. '悬浮轻盈感'：鞋悬浮空中，鞋带动态悬挂，传达顶级舒适感和轻盈感。 6. '感官质地'：聚焦天鹅绒或光滑皮革上部与粗糙石头纹理对比的触感氛围镜头。 7. '单色奢华'：背景与鞋的强调色完美匹配的色块场景，营造大胆编辑感。 8. '解构工艺'：原始材料的抽象排列（皮革样本、橡胶纹理）环绕鞋子，象征高质量构造。 9. '超现实融合'：鞋融入超现实梦幻景观，融合现实主义与高级时尚。 视觉规则： * '主体'：Alexander McQueen男士超大运动鞋。 * '一致性'：鞋的形状、比例、鞋底厚度、标志位置和排版必须100%准确。 * '无扭曲'：标志性鞋底或品牌无变形。 * '分离'：鞋与背景清晰分离。 灯光与风格： * 柔和受控的工作室灯光，具有戏剧性边光突显鞋的轮廓。 * 皮革上的细微高光，鞋底下深层逼真阴影。 * 高动态范围，8K分辨率，超锐利焦点。 * 编辑奢侈时尚广告美学（Vogue/GQ风格）。 * 调色板：极简主义、单色、金属和深哑光色调。 整体氛围： * 现代、精致、视觉连贯。 * 奢侈时尚品牌高端商业活动。 * 超现实、电影感、精致和渴望感。

title: 唯美胶片感九格连拍手持郁金香人像
打破次元壁：现实与动漫角色的梦幻客厅
promptEn: A high-fidelity, wide-angle interior shot captures a surreal, mixed-media composition within a modern living room. It features a man resembling the face in the reference photo—using an uploaded face as a reference—wearing a bright yellow hoodie and black pants, sitting centrally on a plush light gray sofa. The scene seamlessly blends photorealistic 3D environments with cel-shaded 2D anime and cartoon characters interacting directly with the physical space. On the right side of the subject on the sofa, Nobita sits casually waving his hand, while on the left side, Doraemon leans casually on a pillow. Behind the sofa, two framed posters hang on the white wall—one featuring Son Goku and Vegeta, and the other featuring Trunks in a dynamic anime style. In the foreground, Shinchan lies relaxed on a textured gray carpet near a plate of dorayaki, while a chibi version of Son Goku stands triumphantly on a cream-colored knit pouf. On the left side of the room, Vegeta stands tall on a grooved wooden side table in a confident pose, while a miniature version of Trunks is near the wooden coffee table in the center, as if observing the scene with a curious expression. Soft natural light streams in from the left side through sheer curtains, creating subtle volumetric lighting that accentuates the texture of the blanket, the wood grain of the tiered table, and the leaves of the snake plant in the corner of the room. The entire scene is rendered in 8K resolution with sharp focus, vivid colors, and a dreamy, cinematic, and playful aesthetic blending between the real world and the anime world, with no AI visible.
promptCh: 一张高保真、广角室内照片，捕捉了现代客厅中超现实的混合媒体构图。画面中，一名男子（其面部特征与参考照片中的面部相似，即使用上传的面部作为参考）身穿亮黄色连帽衫和黑色裤子，居中坐在一个豪华的浅灰色沙发上。场景无缝融合了逼真的 3D 环境与赛璐珞风格的 2D 动漫和卡通人物，这些人物直接与物理空间互动。 在沙发上人物的右侧，Nobita 随意地挥着手坐着；而在左侧，Doraemon 随意地靠在一个枕头上。沙发后面，白色墙壁上挂着两幅带框海报——一幅是孙悟空和贝吉塔，另一幅是动态动漫风格的特兰克斯。前景中，Shinchan 慵懒地躺在纹理灰色的地毯上，旁边放着一盘铜锣烧，而一个 Q 版的孙悟空则得意洋洋地站在一个奶油色的针织坐垫上。房间左侧，贝吉塔自信地站立在一个带凹槽的木制边桌上，而一个迷你版的特兰克斯则在中央的木制咖啡桌旁，仿佛好奇地观察着这个场景。 柔和的自然光从左侧透过薄纱窗帘洒入，营造出微妙的体积光，突出了毯子的纹理、分层桌子的木纹以及房间角落虎皮兰的叶子。整个场景以 8K 分辨率渲染，具有锐利的焦点、鲜艳的色彩，以及介于现实世界和动漫世界之间的梦幻、电影感和俏皮美学，且没有可见的 AI 痕迹。

title: 岁月长河中的凝视：水面倒影映照前世今生
promptEn: A cinematic movie poster with a dual-perspective 'mirror' effect. The top half features a uploaded man in a polo shirt and jeans standing in a cold, blue-toned urban environment with a misty city skyline. title: 诗中世界：经典名著的微缩立体透视
promptEn: you are a world class visual artist and viral content generator tasked with creating high-concept diorama for poems. For every input, you will find their 4 most famous works, analyze the core identity, the defining artifacts, the atmosphere, characters and the underlying narrative of the subject. you will then construct a specific container, the appropriate shell based on the title and year it was made: for any title, analyze the mechanics and aesthetic. visualize a hollowed-out item. the interior is a diorama of a famous level. it contains miniature elements, assets, tiny protagonist, and other relevant elements to the subject. lighting & style should be appropriate for the title. Output 2x2 grid, each with a diorama of each poem
promptCh: 你是一位世界级的视觉艺术家和病毒式内容创作者，任务是为诗歌创作高概念立体模型。对于每一个输入，你将找出其 4 部最著名的作品，分析其核心特征、标志性元素、氛围、人物以及潜在叙事。然后，你将根据作品的标题和创作年份，构建一个特定的容器，即合适的“外壳”：对于任何标题，分析其机制和美学。设想一个被掏空的物品。其内部是一个著名关卡的立体模型。它包含微缩元素、道具、微型主角以及其他与主题相关的元素。灯光和风格应与作品标题相符。输出 2x2 网格，每个网格包含一首诗歌的立体模型。

title: 奢华衣帽间里的绅士镜面自拍

沐浴金色阳光的慵懒雀斑少女特写
绿意虚化前景中沉浸阅读的静谧时光
promptEn: Create a photo of a person based on the reference photo without changing his face and hair. The composition is very calm. Emphasize a feeling of peaceful solitude. Place the focus in the middle of nature. In the middle of a grassy field, a man sits on a black folding chair. It is a camping chair. He looks focused while reading an open novel. He wears the same outfit as in the reference photo. He wears white Asics Gel-1130 shoes, with a small part of white socks visible. He uses white Bluetooth earphones, showing that he is listening to music to help him concentrate. His hair is slightly messy from the wind but still looks neat. His sitting posture is relaxed but upright. He looks fully absorbed in his activity. The photo is taken from a distance using a long shot technique. The photographer appears to shoot from behind a mound of grass or bushes. A large green bokeh effect fills the foreground. Plants in the foreground and a tree branch in the upper right create a natural frame that directs the viewer’s eye to the subject in the center. The human subject looks small compared to the wide green landscape. This highlights a positive sense of solitude and the calmness of the open space. The background is a hill or a sloping meadow with a fresh and even green color. The grass texture looks smooth. In the far upper left, a small part of a path or a lighter ground area is visible. The light is soft and even, like on a slightly cloudy day or in the afternoon. There are no harsh shadows or distracting contrasts. The dominant colors are dark green and light green, which create a calming and refreshing mood. The contrast between the dark outfit and the white earphones makes the subject stand out without breaking the harmony of the natural colors. Aspect ratio 3:4.
promptCh: 根据参考照片创作一张人物照片，不改变其面部和发型。构图非常平静。强调一种宁静的独处感。将焦点置于大自然中央。在一片草地中央，一名男子坐在一张黑色的折叠椅上。这是一把露营椅。他专注地阅读一本打开的小说。他穿着与参考照片中相同的服装。他穿着白色的 Asics Gel-1130 运动鞋，露出一小部分白色袜子。他戴着白色的蓝牙耳机，表明他正在听音乐以帮助集中注意力。他的头发被风吹得略显凌乱，但仍然整洁。他的坐姿放松但挺拔。他看起来完全沉浸在自己的活动中。照片采用远景拍摄技术，从远处拍摄。摄影师似乎是从草堆或灌木丛后面拍摄的。前景中充满大面积的绿色散景效果。前景中的植物和右上角的树枝形成一个自然的画框，将观者的视线引向中央的主体。与广阔的绿色景观相比，人物主体显得很小。这突出了积极的独处感和开阔空间的宁静。背景是山丘或倾斜的草地，呈现清新均匀的绿色。草地纹理看起来很平滑。在左上角远处，可以看到一小部分小径或较浅的地面区域。光线柔和均匀，如同微阴天或午后。没有刺眼的阴影或分散注意力的对比。主导颜色是深绿色和浅绿色，营造出平静和清新的氛围。深色服装和白色耳机之间的对比使主体脱颖而出，同时又不破坏自然色彩的和谐。长宽比 3:4。

title: 喧嚣中的静止：穿连帽衫男子吃卷饼的商业摄影
promptEn: Medium shot of a young man in a black hoodie, perfectly still and sharp, calmly eating a taco while holding a paper tray of three tacos. The background is a heavily motion-blurred crowd creating horizontal chaotic streaks in dark earth tones. title: 穿越时空的宏大螺旋历史演进纪念碑
promptEn: Do this for literature: Input A is a Topic with a clear historical progression (e.g., Literature, Medicine, Flight, Computing). Deconstruct the history into 4 Vertical Eras : Level 1 (The Foundation - Bottom): The Ancient Origin. (e.g., Literature -> Stone Tablets & Scrolls. Flight -> Da Vinci Wings & Kites). Level 2 (The Tradition - Lower Mid): The Medieval/Renaissance Era. (e.g., Literature -> Scriptorium & Monks. Flight -> Hot Air Balloons). Level 3 (The Revolution - Upper Mid): The Industrial Age. (e.g., Literature -> Printing Press & Newspapers. Flight -> Propeller Planes). Level 4 (The Horizon - Top): The Digital/Future Age. (e.g., Literature -> Holographic Data & VR. Flight -> Spacecraft & Ion Thrusters). 2. Container (The Rotunda): Goal: "Museum Installation" 3D Art. The Object: A massive, freestanding Helical Tower Sculpture standing in a dark museum hall. The Base: A circular Bronze Plinth with a gold plaque reading: "THE EVOLUTION OF [INPUT A]". 3. The Structure (The Spiral): The Spine: A central mechanical or architectural pillar supports the structure. The Ramp: A continuous, wide Spiral Ramp winds upwards around the central pillar (like the Tower of Babel or DNA). The Vignettes: Along the ramp at each level, detailed Architectural Dioramas are built: Bottom: Stone arches, caves, or temples. Middle: Timber frames, brick factories, or iron trusses. Top: Floating glass platforms, laser grids, or cloud computing nodes. 4. The Narrative Scale (The Population): Scale: 1:50 Scale Figures. Action: At every level, figures are actively "working" on the technology of their time (e.g., Scribes writing, Mechanics wrenching, Cyborgs interfacing).
promptCh: 请为文学创作此内容： 输入 A 是一个具有清晰历史演进的主题（例如，文学、医学、飞行、计算机）。 将历史解构为 4 个垂直时代： 第一层（基础 - 底部）：古代起源。 （例如，文学 -> 石碑和卷轴。飞行 -> 达芬奇之翼和风筝）。 第二层（传统 - 中下）：中世纪/文艺复兴时期。 （例如，文学 -> 抄写室和僧侣。飞行 -> 热气球）。 第三层（革命 - 中上）：工业时代。 （例如，文学 -> 印刷机和报纸。飞行 -> 螺旋桨飞机）。 第四层（前瞻 - 顶部）：数字/未来时代。 （例如，文学 -> 全息数据和 VR。飞行 -> 宇宙飞船和离子推进器）。 2. 容器（圆形大厅）： 目标：“博物馆装置” 3D 艺术。 物体：一座巨大的、独立的螺旋塔雕塑，矗立在黑暗的博物馆大厅中。 底座：一个圆形青铜基座，上面有一块金色牌匾，上面写着：“[输入 A] 的演变”。 3. 结构（螺旋）： 主干：一个中央机械或建筑支柱支撑着整个结构。 坡道：一条连续的、宽阔的螺旋坡道围绕着中央支柱向上盘旋（就像巴别塔或 DNA）。 小场景：在坡道的每一层，都建造了详细的建筑立体模型： 底部：石拱门、洞穴或寺庙。 中部：木结构、砖厂或铁桁架。 顶部：浮动玻璃平台、激光网格或云计算节点。 4. 叙事规模（人口）： 比例：1:50 比例人物模型。 动作：在每个层面，人物模型都在积极地“操作”他们那个时代的技术（例如，抄写员书写，机械师扳手操作，赛博格进行界面交互）。

promptEn: Dessert Name: A hyper-realistic luxury dessert still life inspired by the dessert named "". The dessert’s form and structure accurately match the real-world dessert implied by the name (cake, tart, mousse, pastry, soufflé, chocolate dessert, parfait, custard, etc.), presented as an elegant, indulgent centerpiece with a refined pink-toned luxury palette. If the dessert implies a molten center, lava, glaze, or soft interior, the molten element is abundant, thick, glossy, and slow-flowing, emerging generously with smooth ribbons and slight pooling, clean and appetizing rather than messy. The dessert is displayed in an ornate vintage crystal dessert goblet or dish appropriate to its form, with faceted crystal details and a solid, elegant base. The upper surface is lightly dusted with ultra-fine diamond-like glitter, behaving purely as delicate optical sparkle, extremely fine, naturally scattered, with no visible grains and no interaction with liquids. Diamonds are arranged in a clear hierarchy: several oversized hero diamonds, many medium-sized supporting diamonds and gemstones, and subtle micro sparkle. Size contrast is strong and intentional, creating depth and richness without uniformity. All diamonds and gemstones sit dry and clean on the dessert surface, completely separate from any lava, glaze, cream, or syrup. Each stone has sharp brilliant-cut facets, strong internal refraction, high refractive index, and crystal-clear transparency. Only 3–5 stones emit controlled starburst flares; all others remain softly reflective. All molten elements, glazes, syrups, or creams remain pure and uninterrupted, with no solid inclusions. Garnishes implied by the dessert name appear naturally and refined. Centered symmetrical hero composition, slight low-angle view, seamless dark red to black gradient background, high-jewelry advertising lighting, ultra-detailed, cinematic realism, premium beauty commercial aesthetic.
promptCh: 甜点名称： 一张超现实的奢华甜点静物照，灵感来源于名为“”的甜点。甜点的形状和结构精确匹配其名称所暗示的真实甜点（蛋糕、蛋挞、慕斯、糕点、舒芙蕾、巧克力甜点、冻糕、蛋奶沙司等），呈现为一件优雅、奢华的中心装饰品，采用精致的粉色调奢华配色。 如果甜点暗示有流心、熔岩、淋面或柔软的内部，则流心元素应丰富、浓稠、光泽饱满、缓慢流动，大量涌出，形成光滑的丝带并略微汇聚，干净诱人而非凌乱。 甜点盛放在与其形状相称的华丽复古水晶甜点高脚杯或盘中，带有刻面水晶细节和坚固优雅的底座。 甜点上表面轻轻撒上超细的钻石般闪粉，纯粹作为精致的光学闪光，极其细腻，自然散布，没有可见颗粒，不与液体相互作用。 钻石排列具有清晰的层次感：几颗超大号的主钻，许多中等大小的辅助钻石和宝石，以及微妙的微闪。尺寸对比强烈且有意为之，营造出深度和丰富感，而非单一均匀。 所有钻石和宝石都干燥清洁地置于甜点表面，完全独立于任何熔岩、淋面、奶油或糖浆。每颗宝石都具有锋利的明亮式切面、强烈的内部折射、高折射率和晶莹剔透的透明度。只有 3-5 颗宝石发出受控的星爆光芒；其余的则保持柔和的反光。 所有流心元素、淋面、糖浆或奶油都保持纯净无暇，没有固体夹杂物。甜点名称所暗示的装饰物自然而精致地呈现。 居中对称的主体构图，略微低角度视角，无缝的深红到黑色渐变背景，高级珠宝广告照明，超细节，电影级真实感，高端美妆商业美学。

title: 冬日暖阳下身着红毛衣的温润男子肖像
promptEn: Concept & Mood Intimate lifestyle–fashion editorial with quiet masculine warmth and thoughtful calm. Soft, cozy atmosphere reminiscent of a private winter afternoon spent reading indoors. Emotional restraint with gentle confidence — reflective, composed, subtly romantic without performance. Feels like a real, candid moment captured naturally, not posed or styled for effect. --- Subject & Anatomy Adult man with realistic proportions and natural build. Relaxed posture with subtle asymmetry — body leaning forward slightly, one arm resting on the table, head supported by the hand. Natural weight distribution through the elbow and forearm resting on the surface. No tension in the shoulders or neck, posture feels unforced and comfortable. --- Pose & Perspective Seated at a wooden table indoors. Head gently tilted, cheek resting against the palm of the hand. Other arm relaxed and folded near an open book on the table. Camera positioned at eye level, slightly off-center, creating an intimate, conversational perspective. Framing is mid-close portrait, focusing on face, hands, and upper torso. --- Face & Expression Soft, calm expression with a subtle, knowing half-smile. Eyes relaxed and warm, making gentle eye contact with the camera. Brows natural and expressive, conveying ease and quiet confidence rather than performance. Facial hair neatly groomed with realistic density and texture. --- Skin (Key Focus) Highly realistic skin texture featuring: visible pores natural tonal variation subtle under-eye texture realistic beard shadow and transitions Skin appears alive and tactile. No smoothing, no beauty retouching, no artificial glow or plastic finish. --- Hair & Grooming Medium-length dark hair with natural volume and movement. Softly tousled with slight wave, imperfect strands falling naturally across the forehead. Hair density realistic, not styled or over-defined. Beard neatly trimmed, edges soft and organic, not sharply sculpted. --- Wardrobe & Styling Cozy red knit sweater with small white heart motifs. Fabric appears thick and warm, with: visible knit texture realistic folds and stretch around elbows and shoulders natural drape and compression at contact points Sweater reads as casual, intimate, and personal — not fashion-staged. --- Environment & Props Simple indoor setting with a wooden table surface. An open book placed naturally in front of the subject, pages slightly curved and imperfect. Background softly blurred, suggesting a quiet home or café interior. No distracting elements, environment supports calm and intimacy. --- Lighting Soft natural window light only. Light falls gently across the face, creating smooth highlight-to-shadow transitions. Warm, diffused illumination with no harsh shadows. No artificial lighting, no flash, no studio feel. --- Camera & Optics Photographer mindset. Full-frame look with a 50–55mm perspective.
promptCh: 概念与氛围 私密的生活方式–时尚编辑，带有宁静的男性温暖和深思熟虑的平静。 柔软、舒适的氛围，让人联想到在室内阅读的私人冬日午后。 情感克制，带着温柔的自信——沉思、沉着、微妙的浪漫，不刻意表演。 感觉像是一个真实、坦诚的瞬间被自然捕捉，没有摆拍或刻意造型。 --- 主体与解剖 成年男性，比例真实，体格自然。 放松的姿势，略带不对称——身体略微前倾，一只手臂搭在桌上，头部由手支撑。 重量通过肘部和前臂自然分布在表面。 肩膀和颈部没有紧张感，姿势感觉自然舒适。 --- 姿势与视角 坐在室内的木桌旁。 头部微微倾斜，脸颊靠在手掌上。 另一只手臂放松地放在桌上翻开的书旁。 相机位于视线水平，略微偏离中心，营造出亲密、对话般的视角。 构图为中近景肖像，聚焦于面部、手部和上半身。 --- 面部与表情 柔和、平静的表情，带着一丝微妙、会意的半笑。 眼睛放松而温暖，与镜头进行温柔的眼神交流。 眉毛自然而富有表现力，传达出自在和安静的自信，而非刻意表演。 面部毛发修剪整齐，密度和质感真实。 --- 皮肤（重点） 高度真实的皮肤纹理，特点包括： 可见的毛孔 自然的色调变化 微妙的眼下纹理 真实的胡茬阴影和过渡 皮肤看起来生动且富有触感。 没有平滑处理，没有美颜修饰，没有人工光泽或塑料感。 --- 发型与修饰 中等长度的深色头发，具有自然的蓬松感和动感。 轻柔地蓬乱，略带波浪，不完美的发丝自然地垂落在额头。 头发密度真实，没有刻意造型或过度修饰。 胡须修剪整齐，边缘柔和自然，没有锐利的雕塑感。 --- 服装与造型 舒适的 red 针织毛衣，带有小小的 white heart 图案。 面料看起来厚实保暖，具有： 可见的针织纹理 肘部和肩部周围真实的褶皱和拉伸 接触点自然的垂坠和压缩 毛衣给人休闲、亲密和私人的感觉——而非时尚摆拍。 --- 环境与道具 简单的室内场景，配有木质桌面。 一本翻开的书自然地放在主体前方，书页略微卷曲且不完美。 背景柔和模糊，暗示着一个安静的家或咖啡馆内部。 没有分散注意力的元素，环境烘托出平静和亲密感。 --- 灯光 仅有柔和的自然窗光。 光线柔和地落在脸上，形成平滑的高光到阴影过渡。 温暖、漫射的照明，没有生硬的阴影。 没有人工照明，没有闪光灯，没有影棚感。 --- 相机与光学 摄影师视角。 全画幅效果，50–55mm 视角。

promptEn: 【MODE (Select only one / Multiple forbidden)】 MODE: A / B / C / D •A = Subject Emphasis (Make the main subject stand out at a glance) •B = Spatial Immersion (Enhance depth and realism) •C = Atmosphere (Focus on 'air' such as humidity, temperature, and weight) •D = Cinematic Completion (Prioritize finished quality over flashiness) ⸻ 【Fundamental Objective】 Treat the attached image as the final post-production stage of film production, and finish it as a "completed cut where the change is obvious at a glance" using lens, light, special effects, and color. No need to hold back. However, clarify the process and responsibility, and avoid overdoing it. ⸻ 【Starting Frame (Absolute)】 Use the attached image as is. Do not change the composition, subject, placement, orientation, or ratio at all. Do not change the camera position. Trimming is forbidden. Do not add or remove new objects, text, or decorations. ⸻ 【Fixed Conditions (Absolute Compliance / Change Forbidden)】 Time of day, weather, season, and story situation are invariant. Directing that misleads these is forbidden. Only the "appearance" can be directed. ⸻ 【Process 1: Lens Redesign (Must create a “structural change”)】 Analyze the lens characteristics of the original image (impression of focal length / depth of field / peripheral depiction), and clearly change them to the physical characteristics of a cinema lens. Must redesign the following: •Impression of focal length •Depth of field •Peripheral depiction (bokeh, vignetting, aberration) Lens Policy by MODE (Must follow) •MODE A: Prioritize separation of the main subject. Background organization. Shallow depth is forbidden, but move towards a depth where “only the main subject is clear.” Light vignetting guides the gaze to the center. •MODE B: Prioritize spatial depth. Move towards a depth where the distance from foreground to far background can be read. Peripheral information remains, and the space is not interrupted. •MODE C: Prioritize the layer of air. Natural impression in the standard range. Density is felt through gradation and subtle blurring (but turbidity is forbidden). •MODE D: Prioritize cinematic stability. Extreme bokeh or exaggeration is forbidden. Aberration is suppressed, and the lens feel is integrated with dignity. Pass Condition for this process: It must be obvious at a glance that the three-dimensional structure of the image has changed compared to the original image. ⸻ 【Process 2: Lighting Reconstruction (Gaze Guidance)】 Addition and emphasis of light sources are permitted. However, new light must only be within the “narratively plausible range.” Light that misleads the time of day or weather is forbidden. Light must always be used to guide the gaze to the main subject. Lighting Policy by MODE •MODE A: Organize the key/rim/reflection of the main subject to enhance presence, and suppress the background. •MODE B: Create a light gradient from foreground → midground → background, guiding the gaze in the depth direction. •MODE C: Emphasize diffused light and wrap-around light to increase the density of the entire space (do not overly strengthen the sense of light source). •MODE D: Unnatural highlights are forbidden. Prioritize the “organization” of existing light and adjust it to natural cinematic lighting. ⸻ 【Process 3: Special Effects (Tactile Sense of Space)】 Purpose is not flashiness but the “feeling of being able to touch the space.” Permitted use: volume light / airborne particles / mist, haze, humidity / subtle lens flare / light scattering. Effects should not be applied uniformly and should not interfere with the main subject. Input Amount by MODE •MODE A: Minimum. Only around the main subject and the path of the gaze. •MODE B: Medium. Create layers in the depth direction. •MODE C: Trace amount, but exists as “density” throughout (do not make it stand out). •MODE D: Invisible level. Dignity that is unnoticed even if present. ⸻ 【Process 4: Color Grading (Role Reallocation)】 Hue is maintained. Do not add color, but clarify roles. Reallocate saturation, contrast, and brightness, and integrate into a cinematic tone. Color Policy by MODE •MODE A: Prioritize the clarity and separation of the main subject. Suppress saturation/information in the background. •MODE B: Support the space with layers of color in the depth direction. Emphasize gradation. •MODE C: Moderate saturation, express air with differences in brightness and subtle color temperature. •MODE D: LUT feel is forbidden. Prioritize unity and dignity, and avoid excessive assertion. ⸻ 【Process 5: Final Check (Required)】 Satisfy all of the following: •The difference is obvious at a glance when compared side-by-side with the original image •It does not feel like the situation has changed (time of day, weather, season, story remain invariant) •Light and special effects do not look overdone •It functions as a single cinematic cut •Ultra-high definition. Film quality.
promptCh: 【模式 (只能选择一个 / 禁止多选)】 模式: A / B / C / D •A = 主体突出 (让主要主体一目了然) •B = 空间沉浸 (增强深度和真实感) •C = 氛围感 (关注湿度、温度、重量等“空气感”) •D = 电影级完成度 (优先考虑完成质量而非华丽程度) ⸻ 【基本目标】 将附带图像视为电影制作的后期制作阶段，使用镜头、光线、特效和色彩，将其完成为“一眼就能看出明显变化的完成剪辑”。 无需保留。但是，请明确过程和责任，避免过度处理。 ⸻ 【起始帧 (绝对)】 按原样使用附带图像。 不得改变构图、主体、位置、方向或比例。 不得改变摄像机位置。禁止裁剪。 不得添加或删除新对象、文本或装饰。 ⸻ 【固定条件 (绝对遵守 / 禁止更改)】 时间、天气、季节和故事情境保持不变。 禁止误导这些的导演。 只能指导“外观”。 ⸻ 【流程 1: 镜头重新设计 (必须创建“结构性变化”)】 分析原始图像的镜头特征 (焦距印象 / 景深 / 周边描绘)，并将其明确更改为电影镜头的物理特征。 必须重新设计以下内容: •焦距印象 •景深 •周边描绘 (散景、暗角、像差) 各模式的镜头策略 (必须遵循) •模式 A: 优先分离主要主体。背景组织。禁止浅景深，但要向“只有主要主体清晰”的景深移动。轻微暗角引导视线到中心。 •模式 B: 优先空间深度。向前景到远背景的距离可读的景深移动。周边信息保留，空间不中断。 •模式 C: 优先空气层。标准范围内的自然印象。通过渐变和微妙模糊感受密度 (但禁止浑浊)。 •模式 D: 优先电影稳定性。禁止极端散景或夸张。抑制像差，镜头感与庄重感融为一体。 此流程的通过条件: 与原始图像相比，图像的三维结构发生变化必须一目了然。 ⸻ 【流程 2: 光照重建 (视线引导)】 允许添加和强调光源。 但是，新光源必须仅在“叙事上合理”的范围内。 禁止误导时间或天气的光线。 光线必须始终用于引导视线到主要主体。 各模式的光照策略 •模式 A: 组织主要主体的关键光/轮廓光/反射光以增强存在感，并抑制背景。 •模式 B: 创建从前景 → 中景 → 背景的光线渐变，在深度方向引导视线。 •模式 C: 强调漫射光和环绕光，以增加整个空间的密度 (不要过度增强光源感)。 •模式 D: 禁止不自然的强光。优先“组织”现有光线，并将其调整为自然的电影光照。 ⸻ 【流程 3: 特效 (空间的触感)】 目的不是华丽，而是“能够触摸到空间的感觉”。 允许使用: 体积光 / 空中颗粒 / 薄雾、雾霾、湿度 / 微妙的镜头光晕 / 光散射。 效果不应均匀应用，也不应干扰主要主体。 各模式的输入量 •模式 A: 最小。仅在主要主体周围和视线路径上。 •模式 B: 中等。在深度方向创建层次。 •模式 C: 微量，但以“密度”形式存在于整个空间 (不要使其突出)。 •模式 D: 不可见的水平。即使存在也察觉不到的庄重感。 ⸻ 【流程 4: 色彩分级 (角色重新分配)】 色相保持不变。不添加颜色，但明确角色。 重新分配饱和度、对比度和亮度，并整合到电影色调中。 各模式的色彩策略 •模式 A: 优先主要主体的清晰度和分离。抑制背景的饱和度/信息。 •模式 B: 通过深度方向的色彩层次支持空间。强调渐变。 •模式 C: 适度饱和，通过亮度和微妙色温差异表达空气感。 •模式 D: 禁止 LUT 感。优先统一性和庄重感，避免过度强调。 ⸻ 【流程 5: 最终检查 (必需)】 满足以下所有条件: •与原始图像并排比较时，差异一目了然 •不觉得情境发生变化 (时间、天气、季节、故事保持不变) •光线和特效看起来不过度 •它作为一个单一的电影剪辑发挥作用 •超高清晰度。电影质量。

promptCh: 编辑图片：一张令人惊叹的高保真图像，由五个大小不一、无缝融合的矩形画框构成，捕捉了日本夜间祭典中的主体。构图巧妙地平衡，呈现出“Kine-style”或当代日本摄影美学，注重诗意的光线和负空间。 画框与姿态： * 背影剪影：双臂举成 V 字形，以发光的摩天轮为背景，金色光线溢出。 * 直视：坐在工业菱形钢板台阶上，沐浴在柔和、漫射的蓝色时分光线中。 * 电影侧影：若有所思地坐在混凝土台阶上，附近霓虹灯投下戏剧性的阴影和锐利的高光。 * 空灵倚靠：靠在白色网状围栏上，向上凝视，纸灯笼的暖色散景融入背景。 * 轻松斜躺：仰卧在木制台阶上，双手枕于脑后，棱镜光线从画框上边缘溢出。 造型与光线： 她身穿白色平纹针织 T 恤，外搭蓝色牛仔背带裤。光线极其丰富，呈现出复杂的光影效果：棱镜镜头光晕、深红色灯笼周围柔和的光晕，以及突出混凝土和钢铁纹理的忧郁明暗对比。 技术美学： 使用 35mm 胶片拍摄（Portra 400质感），色彩分级是去饱和的青色和温暖怀旧的黄色之间精致的融合。图像呈现出细腻、有机的胶片颗粒感、柔和的柔焦光晕，以及深沉、富有氛围的“艺术影院”丰富感。氛围既充满活力又私密，将热闹的节日能量与宁静、深情的内省融为一体。

title: 疯狂动物城搭档与真人的阿尔卑斯雪站之旅
promptEn: A cinematic winter travel moment set at a quiet Alpine mountain station just after snowfall. A young man stands near the edge of a snow - dusted platform, wearing a matte black puffer jacket over a neutral sweater, dark jeans, and winter boots. His posture is relaxed, hands in pockets, breath faintly visible in the cold air, with a calm, confident expression and natural, realistic skin texture. Beside him, Nick Wilde from Zootopia leans against a metal railing, hands casually folded, wearing his signature green shirt and striped tie, giving a knowing side - smirk as if mid - conversation. A few steps away, Judy Hopps stands atop a snow - covered luggage crate, adjusting her blue police uniform with an upbeat, alert expression, ears slightly raised. In the background, towering snow - covered Alpine peaks fade into soft atmospheric haze. A red mountain train slowly departs the station, leaving subtle motion blur and a sense of journey. Cold winter daylight, soft diffused light reflecting off the snow, realistic shadows grounded in the environment. Ultra - detailed textures, crisp winter air, cinematic depth of field. Photorealistic human seamlessly blended with high - quality animated characters. Travel - film aesthetic, emotionally warm yet minimal, high resolution, 4:5 aspect ratio.
promptCh: 一场电影般的冬季旅行场景，设定在刚下过雪的宁静高山车站。一名年轻男子站在被雪覆盖的站台边缘，身穿哑光黑色羽绒服，内搭中性毛衣，下穿深色牛仔裤和冬靴。他姿态放松，双手插兜，在寒冷的空气中呼吸依稀可见，表情平静而自信，皮肤纹理自然逼真。 他身旁，《疯狂动物城》中的尼克·王尔德倚靠在金属栏杆上，双手随意交叠，穿着他标志性的绿色衬衫和条纹领带，带着意味深长的侧身微笑，仿佛正在交谈。几步之外，朱迪·霍普斯站在一个被雪覆盖的行李箱上，调整着她的蓝色警服，表情 upbeat 且警觉，耳朵微微竖起。 背景中，白雪皑皑的阿尔卑斯山峰在柔和的大气薄雾中渐渐隐去。一列红色山地火车缓缓驶离车站，留下微妙的动态模糊和一种旅途感。寒冷的冬日阳光，柔和的漫射光线从雪面反射，真实的阴影与环境融为一体。超精细纹理，清冽的冬日空气，电影般的景深。逼真的人物与高质量的动画角色无缝融合。旅行电影美学，情感温暖而简约，高分辨率，4:5 宽高比。

版式：主图 + 多角度侧边栏 - 不对称的时尚杂志版式。 
画册格式与图片布局： 画册内页以略微倾斜的角度打开，放置在抛光石面上。半光泽纸张，可见纸张纹理，墨水反光真实。四格拍立得风格照片序列，精确的 2×2 网格，带有细黑色分隔线。

左下角画框：丝巾已取下。左臂抬至头后。上半身略微转动。头部向上抬起，眼睛看向相机上方。

风格关键词： 奶油色，浅亚麻，自然光，低调魅力。

Environment & Lighting:
Lighting: Direct, bright natural daylight. The sun creates high - contrast highlights on the knit texture of the dress and casts sharp, defined shadows that define the anatomical depth of her silhouette.
Background (SHARP): A detailed sandy beach environment with visible footprints and coarse sand textures. Every grain of sand and every stitch of the dress is perfectly IN FOCUS. No artificial blur.

title: 金色华服女子的歌剧院奢华背影
赛博工业风硬表面机械重构设计
promptEn:
<instructions> Input Variable: [INSERT OBJECT] (e.g., A Sneaker, A Human Skull, A Cheeseburger, The Letter 'A') System Instruction: Reimagine the Input Object as a complex, high - performance Cyber - Industrial Assembly. 
1. Deconstruction: 
    - The Shell: Replace the object's natural skin with Matte Black Carbon Fiber and Gunmetal Grey Polymer. 
    - The Segmentation: The object is not solid. It is segmented into distinct panels (like Iron Man armor or a high - end camera body), held together by visible Hex Bolts and Rivets. 
    - The Gaps: Between the panels, leave small gaps to reveal the internal mechanics. 
2. Internal Mechanics : 
    - The Piping: Where organic veins or structure would be, insert Bundled Industrial Cabling and Braided Steel Hoses. 
    - The Flow: These cables must look functional, routing power from a central core to the extremities of the object. 
    - The Glow (The Soul): 
        - Color: Identify the "Spirit Color" of the object (e.g., Burger = Amber/Orange; Skull = Cyan/Blue; Sneaker = Neon Green). 
        - Source: Hidden LED strips and neon tubes run parallel to the cables, casting a strong internal glow that spills out from the panel gaps. 
3. The Narrative Micro - Detail (The Greebles): 
    - Scale Indicators: Embed tiny technical details to sell the scale. 
    - Vents: Cooling fans or intake grilles. 
    - Text: Tiny white serial numbers and warning labels (e.g., "CAUTION: HOT", "NO STEP") printed on the casing. 
    - The "City" (Optional): If the object is large enough, tiny architectural elements (antennas, platforms) can grow out of the mechanical base. 
4. Visual Syntax & Composition: 
    - Background: Clean Studio Grey (Infinite Curve). The focus is entirely on the object's silhouette. 
    - Lighting: 
        - Key Light: Soft white studio light to highlight the texture of the carbon fiber weave. 
        - Rim Light: A sharp backlight to define the edge of the object against the grey background. 
        - Bloom: The internal colored LEDs must have a soft "Octane Bloom" effect. 
5. Render Style: 
    - Aesthetic: Hard Surface Modeling, "Tech - Wear" Fashion, High - End Automotive Design. 
    - Camera: Isometric or 3/4 Product Shot angle. 
    - Output: Photorealistic 3D Render, 8k, Highly Detailed Textures (Carbon Fiber, Brushed Metal, Rubber). </instructions>
promptCh:
<instructions> Input Variable: [插入物体]（例如：运动鞋、人头骨、芝士汉堡、字母“A”） 系统指令： 将输入物体重新构想为复杂的、高性能的赛博工业装配体。 
1. 解构： 
    - 外壳：将物体的自然表皮替换为哑光黑色碳纤维和炮铜灰色聚合物。 
    - 分段：物体并非实心。它被分割成不同的面板（类似于钢铁侠的盔甲或高端相机机身），通过可见的内六角螺栓和铆钉连接在一起。 
    - 缝隙：在面板之间留出小缝隙，以展现内部机械结构。 
2. 内部机械结构： 
    - 管道：在原有有机血管或结构的位置，插入成束的工业电缆和编织钢软管。 
    - 流动：这些电缆必须看起来功能齐全，将电力从中央核心输送到物体的各个末端。 
    - 光芒（灵魂）： 
        - 颜色：确定物体的“灵魂颜色”（例如：汉堡 = 琥珀色/橙色；头骨 = 青色/蓝色；运动鞋 = 霓虹绿）。 
        - 光源：隐藏的 LED 灯条和霓虹灯管与电缆平行，发出强烈的内部光芒，从面板缝隙中溢出。 
3. 叙事微细节（小零件）： 
    - 比例指示器：嵌入微小的技术细节以体现比例。 
    - 通风口：冷却风扇或进气格栅。 
    - 文字：外壳上印有微小的白色序列号和警告标签（例如：“注意：高温”、“禁止踩踏”）。 
    - “城市”（可选）：如果物体足够大，微小的建筑元素（天线、平台）可以从机械底座上生长出来。 
4. 视觉语法与构图： 
    - 背景：干净的摄影棚灰色（无限曲线）。焦点完全集中在物体的轮廓上。 
    - 灯光： 
        - 主光：柔和的白色摄影棚灯光，以突出碳纤维编织的纹理。 
        - 轮廓光：锐利的背光，以勾勒物体在灰色背景下的边缘。 
        - 辉光：内部彩色 LED 必须具有柔和的“Octane Bloom”效果。 
5. 渲染风格： 
    - 美学：硬表面建模、“科技服饰”时尚、高端汽车设计。 
    - 相机：等距或 3/4 产品拍摄角度。 
    - 输出：照片级 3D 渲染，8k，高度详细的纹理（碳纤维、拉丝金属、橡胶）。 </instructions>

title: 专业级商业摄影后期精修与色彩校正
promptEn:
Eres un experto editor de imágenes profesional. Tu tarea es editar la imagen que te proporcionaré a continuación. Debes realizar las siguientes acciones: 
1. **Análisis Inicial:** Evalúa la imagen en términos de composición, iluminación, colorimetría, nitidez y posibles imperfecciones. 
2. **Corrección de Color y Tono:** Ajusta el balance de blancos, la exposición y el contraste para lograr un aspecto natural y vibrante. Mejora la saturación de manera sutil si es necesario. 
3. **Retoque y Limpieza (si aplica):** Elimina cualquier elemento distractor, manchas o ruido digital. Si es un retrato, suaviza ligeramente la piel manteniendo la textura natural. 
4. **Mejora de Nitidez:** Aplica un enfoque selectivo para resaltar los detalles clave sin introducir artefactos. 
5. **Estilización (Opcional):** Si la imagen lo requiere, aplica un estilo sutil (ej. cinematográfico, vintage, alto contraste) que mejore la narrativa visual sin sobreprocesar. 
6. **Formato de Salida:** Proporciona la imagen editada con la máxima calidad posible y una breve descripción de los cambios realizados. 

**Instrucciones Adicionales:** 
* Prioriza la naturalidad y la calidad profesional. Evita los efectos exagerados. 
* Si la imagen es un retrato, asegúrate de que los ojos estén nítidos y brillantes. 
* Si la imagen es un paisaje, potencia la profundidad y el cielo. 

**Imagen a editar:** [Inserta aquí la imagen]
promptCh: 您是一位专业的图像编辑专家。您的任务是编辑我将在下方提供的图像。您必须执行以下操作： 1. **初步分析：** 从构图、光照、色彩、锐度和可能存在的瑕疵等方面评估图像。 2. **色彩和色调校正：** 调整白平衡、曝光和对比度，以实现自然而充满活力的外观。如有必要，可适度增强饱和度。 3. **修饰和清理（如适用）：** 移除任何分散注意力的元素、瑕疵或数字噪点。如果是肖像，请在保持自然纹理的同时，轻微柔化皮肤。 4. **锐度增强：** 应用选择性对焦以突出关键细节，同时避免引入伪影。 5. **风格化（可选）：** 如果图像需要，可应用微妙的风格（例如，电影感、复古、高对比度），以增强视觉叙事，避免过度处理。 6. **输出格式：** 提供最高质量的编辑图像，并简要描述所做的更改。 **附加说明：** * 优先考虑自然度和专业品质。避免夸张的效果。 * 如果图像是肖像，请确保眼睛锐利明亮。 * 如果图像是风景，请增强景深和天空。 **要编辑的图像：** [在此处插入图像]

Woman with long, dark wavy hair, a seductive smile showcasing perfect white teeth, subtle makeup enhancing her features, wearing a luxurious rose gold puffer jacket, a cashmere cream-colored turtleneck sweater, and a stylish dark brown faux fur headband. Man with neatly styled dark hair, a well-groomed beard, and a confident expression, sporting a designer dark grey waxed canvas baseball cap, a high-end black ski jacket, and dark grey technical backpack straps visible. Candid selfie, faces close together, exuding warmth and a playful vibe. Setting: A breathtaking mountain vista with snow-covered peaks and scattered evergreen trees. Bright daylight creating natural highlights and shadows, cool color temperature with a hint of warmth from the sun. High-resolution smartphone-style photography, close-up perspective, slightly upward angle emphasizing the majestic scenery. Color Palette: Forest Green, Matte Black, Creamy White, Earth Tones, Icy Blue. Sharp focus, realistic skin textures, and a clear depiction of the alpine environment.. A stylish handwritten signature Willy is elegantly and small letters placed at the Bottom Right corner
promptCh: 一对年轻幸福的夫妇在雪山中徒步旅行时，正在拍摄一张特写自拍照。女子留着一头深色波浪长发，笑容迷人，露出洁白的牙齿，淡雅的妆容衬托出她的五官，身穿一件奢华的玫瑰金羽绒服，一件羊绒米色高领毛衣，以及一个时尚的深棕色仿皮草发带。男子留着整齐的深色头发，修剪得体的胡须，表情自信，戴着一顶设计师款深灰色打蜡帆布棒球帽，一件高端黑色滑雪夹克，可见深灰色技术背包的肩带。这是一张抓拍的自拍照，两人脸庞靠近，散发着温暖和俏皮的氛围。背景：壮丽的山景，白雪覆盖的山峰和零星的常绿树木。明亮的日光营造出自然的明暗对比，冷色调中带着一丝阳光的暖意。高分辨率智能手机风格摄影，特写视角，略微仰视的角度突出了雄伟的景色。调色板：森林绿、哑光黑、奶油白、大地色、冰蓝色。对焦锐利，皮肤纹理真实，清晰展现了高山环境。右下角优雅地放置着一个时尚的手写签名，小写字母为 Willy。

title: 霓虹夜色中手持精致面具的绝美时尚大片
深夜闪光灯下的液态金属质感金色长裙
promptEn:
(3:4). A raw, high - contrast night photograph taken with an iPhone 17 Pro. DIRECT HARD SMARTPHONE FLASH. NO ARTIFICIAL BOKEH. Everything is SHARP and in focus from the metallic texture of the dress to the distant bridge cables.
Subject & Identity Locking:
•Identity: Strictly preserve the exact face and unique features of the woman in Image 1 (Selfie).
•Bio - Fidelity: Render high - fidelity "TrueLens" skin physics: visible micro - pores, natural "satin - finish" night hydration glow, and fine vellus hair catching the flash ONLY along the jawline.
•Expression: Looking away from the lens with a soft, radiant "candid" smile. Her hair is straight, long, and dark chestnut.
•Silhouette Calibration: Amplify the dominant structural bust volume and the substantial, thick - toned leg presence. Focus on the aggressive hourglass structural tapering at the waist.
Outfit & Material Realism:
•Clothing: A skin - tight, Metallic Gold Foil - Finish Strapless Bodycon Mini Dress.
•Physics: The fabric has a reflective, liquid - metal sheen under the flash. It shows extreme material tension and a vacuum - tight fit, creating realistic micro - folds at the waist and highlighting her fit, symmetrical proportions.
•Accessories: A beige leather crossbody bag with a delicate gold chain strap. A small silver pendant on a thin chain.
Pose & Composition:
•Pose: She is leaning back against a white slatted bridge railing. Her arms are outstretched to the sides, resting on the railing to accentuate the S - curve of her physique and her fit hourglass form.
•Composition: Medium full - body shot captured by a third person.
Environment & Lighting:
•Lighting: Hard Direct Smartphone Flash. The flash creates brilliant, high - key specular highlights on the metallic dress and her skin, casting a sharp, pitch - black shadow behind her.
•Background (SHARP): A massive, modern illuminated cable - stayed bridge with multiple white glowing support wires radiating like a harp. The bridge and the dark urban foliage below are perfectly IN FOCUS. No artificial blur.
Quality: Raw unedited "night - out" social - media dump aesthetic, high dynamic range, visible digital grain in the deep shadows, 8k resolution.
promptCh:
(3:4). 一张用iPhone 17 Pro拍摄的原始、高对比度夜间照片。直接、强烈的智能手机闪光灯。无人工散景。从连衣裙的金属质感到远处桥梁的缆绳，一切都清晰锐利，对焦准确。 
主体与身份锁定： 
• 身份：严格保留图像1（自拍）中女性的精确面部和独特特征。 
• 生物保真度：呈现高保真度的“TrueLens”皮肤物理效果：可见的微孔、自然的“缎面光泽”夜间水润感，以及仅沿下颌线捕捉到闪光灯的细小绒毛。 
• 表情：目光离开镜头，带着柔和、灿烂的“抓拍式”微笑。她的头发是直的、长的、深栗色的。 
• 轮廓校准：放大突出的结构性胸部体积和结实、厚实的腿部存在感。重点突出腰部激进的沙漏形结构收窄。 
服装与材质真实感： 
• 服装：一件紧身、金属金色箔面无肩带紧身迷你连衣裙。 
• 物理效果：面料在闪光灯下呈现出反光的液态金属光泽。它展现出极端的材料张力和真空般的紧密贴合，在腰部形成逼真的微褶皱，并突显她健美、对称的身材比例。 
• 配饰：一个米色皮革斜挎包，配有精致的金色链条肩带。一条细链上挂着一个小银色吊坠。 
姿势与构图： 
• 姿势：她靠在一座白色板条桥栏杆上。双臂向两侧伸展，搭在栏杆上，以突出她身体的S形曲线和健美的沙漏形身材。 
• 构图：由第三方拍摄的中等全身照。 
环境与光线： 
• 光线：强烈直接的智能手机闪光灯。闪光灯在金属连衣裙和她的皮肤上产生出明亮、高调的镜面高光，在她身后投下锐利、漆黑的阴影。 
• 背景（锐利）：一座巨大的、现代化的照明斜拉桥，多条白色发光的支撑缆绳像竖琴一样放射状展开。桥梁和下方黑暗的城市植被都完美对焦。无人工模糊。 
质量：原始未经编辑的“夜间外出”社交媒体随手拍美学，高动态范围，深色阴影中可见数字颗粒，8k分辨率。

title: 手稿中诞生的黄铜机械科学奇迹
promptEn: <instructions> Role: Science Historian & Kinetic Sculpture Engineer Input: [Scientific Discovery, e.g., DNA Structure, Theory of Relativity] Phase 1: Analysis 1. Identify the "eureka moment" and the failed attempts before it 2. Select 4 lesser - known scientists/discoveries that used similar methodology 3. Extract the physical apparatus used in the discovery (microscope, prism, blackboard equation) Phase 2: Execution Goal: 2x2 Grid of "Working Lab Notebook Contraptions" Rules per Panel: - The Base: An open, coffee - stained lab notebook with handwritten equations/sketches - The Machine: A functional brass and glass apparatus rises FROM the notebook pages (steampunk aesthetic) - The Process: The machine actively demonstrates the discovery (gears turning, liquid flowing, light refracting) - The Scientist: Tiny figurine in period lab coat taking notes with a fountain pen - The Failure: Crossed - out attempts and crumpled paper nearby - The Eureka: A single glowing element (LED) representing the breakthrough moment - The Label: Fountain pen handwriting: "Scientist Name | Discovery | Year | Lab Location" - The Props: Era - accurate items (telegram, slide rule, Bunsen burner, petri dishes) Output: 2x2 Grid, Industrial Scientific Photography, dramatic side lighting </instructions>
promptCh: <instructions> 角色：科学史学家与动力雕塑工程师 输入：[科学发现，例如：DNA 结构，相对论] 阶段 1：分析 1. 找出“尤里卡时刻”以及之前的失败尝试 2. 选择 4 个使用类似方法的鲜为人知的科学家/发现 3. 提取发现中使用的物理设备（显微镜、棱镜、黑板方程） 阶段 2：执行 目标：2x2 的“工作实验室笔记本装置”网格 每个面板的规则： - 基础：一本打开的、沾有咖啡渍的实验笔记本，上面有手写的公式/草图 - 机器：一个功能性的黄铜和玻璃装置从笔记本页面中升起（蒸汽朋克美学） - 过程：机器主动演示发现（齿轮转动、液体流动、光线折射） - 科学家：穿着时代实验服的微型人偶，用钢笔做笔记 - 失败：旁边有划掉的尝试和揉皱的纸张 - 尤里卡：一个发光的元素（LED），代表突破时刻 - 标签：钢笔手写：“科学家姓名 | 发现 | 年份 | 实验室地点” - 道具：符合时代的物品（电报、计算尺、本生灯、培养皿） 输出：2x2 网格，工业科学摄影，戏剧性的侧光 </instructions>

title: 镜中十比五比分狂胜 C 罗的居家名场面
promptEn: A hyper-realistic, ultra-detailed 8K cinematic photograph captured with a 35mm lens, medium-wide shot, set inside a realistic, modern apartment living room with a natural, lived-in home atmosphere. Scene logic & composition: The TV is positioned directly in front of the players and remains outside the camera frame. A large decorative mirror on the wall subtly reflects the TV screen, clearly showing the final match result. In the mirror reflection, the football video game result screen displays a crushing score: 10 – 5, clearly in favor of the main subject. The numbers are bold, bright, and unmistakable against a green pitch and stadium crowd background. In the foreground, the main subject (uploaded 100% face as reference, identity fully locked and preserved) is seated on a comfortable couch, body oriented straight toward the unseen TV. He is wearing a relaxed home tracksuit , calm and confident, with a controlled victorious expression after the dominant win holding a PlayStation controller while smiling . Seated next to him on the couch is Cristiano Ronaldo, holding a PlayStation controller tightly. His body language shows clear frustration and anger: tense jaw, furrowed brows, clenched fists, shoulders tight, leaning forward aggressively. His expression communicates competitive rage and disbelief after losing so badly. Standing slightly behind and to the side of the couch is Lionel Messi and Mbappe, relaxed and casual, eating food from a plate while watching the scene. He is smiling subtly, enjoying the moment, completely calm and unbothered, creating a strong contrast with Ronaldo’s anger and adding humor and human warmth to the scene. A realistic coffee table sits between the couch and the TV, filled with casual home snacks and drinks: pizza slices, chips, sandwiches, and soft drinks, slightly messy to enhance realism. Lighting is soft, cinematic, and natural, combining ambient room light with the reflected TV glow from the mirror, which subtly illuminates faces and hands. Depth of field keeps the faces and mirror reflection sharp while softly blurring background elements. Ultra-realistic skin texture, natural fabric wrinkles, realistic controller reflections, subtle dust particles in the air. Photorealistic, candid, unstaged moment. A perfect balance of tension, humor, and realism
promptCh: 一张超现实、细节丰富的 8K 电影级照片，使用 35mm 镜头拍摄，中景广角，场景设定在一个真实、现代的公寓客厅内，营造出自然、居家、有人气的生活氛围。 场景逻辑与构图： 电视正对着玩家，并保持在镜头画面之外。 墙上的一面大型装饰镜巧妙地反射出电视屏幕，清晰地显示着最终比赛结果。 在镜面反射中，足球视频游戏的结果屏幕显示着压倒性的比分：10 – 5，明显有利于主角。 数字粗体、明亮且清晰可见，背景是绿色的球场和体育场观众。 前景中，主角（100% 面部上传作为参考，身份完全锁定并保留）坐在一张舒适的沙发上，身体正对着看不见的电视。他穿着一套休闲的居家运动服，平静而自信，在取得压倒性胜利后，脸上带着一种克制的胜利表情，手里拿着一个PlayStation手柄，面带微笑。 他旁边坐在沙发上的是Cristiano Ronaldo，紧紧地握着一个PlayStation手柄。 他的肢体语言显示出明显的沮丧和愤怒：下巴紧绷，眉毛紧锁，拳头紧握，肩膀僵硬，身体 aggressively 地前倾。 他的表情传达出在惨败后的竞争性愤怒和难以置信。Lionel Messi和Mbappe站在沙发稍后方和侧面，放松而随意，边吃盘子里的食物边观看这一场景。 他微微笑着，享受着这一刻，完全平静而从容，与Ronaldo的愤怒形成强烈对比，为场景增添了幽默感和人情味。 一张真实的咖啡桌摆在沙发和电视之间，上面摆满了随意的家常零食和饮料：披萨片、薯片、三明治和软饮料，略显凌乱以增强真实感。 灯光柔和、电影感十足且自然，结合了环境室内光线和镜子反射出的电视光芒，微妙地照亮了脸部和手部。 景深使脸部和镜面反射保持清晰，同时柔和地模糊了背景元素。 超真实的皮肤纹理，自然的织物褶皱，逼真的手柄反射，空气中细微的灰尘颗粒。 写实、candid、未经摆拍的瞬间。 紧张、幽默和现实的完美平衡。

title: 极简冷白光下的国风唯美忧郁少女肖像
promptEn: Create an ethereal, atmospheric portrait of a young Asian woman (age 20 - 25) in a dreamlike, melancholic, C - drama/Douyin aesthetic. She has porcelain - smooth skin, soft focus, and a romanticized, otherworldly presence, styled in a black corset top. The lighting is dramatic yet soft, with a strong cool - white light hitting her from the front and side, creating high contrast against a pure deep black background. Add a faint glow around her hair and shoulders for an angelic halo effect, softened with a misty, hazy highlight. Her makeup is soft - glam minimalist. Pose 1: head tilted upward and slightly to the side, one hand resting gently on her collarbone or neck, fingers relaxed, eyes looking away, wind - swept hair partially covering her face, lips slightly parted, conveying introspection and vulnerability. Pose 2: back - to - camera turn, looking over her shoulder, head slightly tilted down, eyes large and expressive, emphasizing jawline and shoulder curve, maintaining the wind - swept hair effect. The overall composition is intimate, cinematic, and moody, capturing delicate vulnerability, soft tactile elegance, and a frozen moment of reflective thought.
promptCh: 创作一幅梦幻、忧郁、具有 C 剧/抖音美学风格的年轻亚洲女性（20 - 25 岁）空灵、氛围感肖像。她拥有瓷器般光滑的肌肤，柔焦效果，散发着浪漫、超凡脱俗的气质，身着黑色束身衣。灯光戏剧化却又柔和，强烈的冷白光从前方和侧面打在她身上，与纯粹的深黑色背景形成强烈对比。在她头发和肩膀周围添加微弱的光晕，营造出天使般的光环效果，并用薄雾般的朦胧高光柔化。她的妆容是柔和精致的极简风格。姿势 1：头部向上微倾，一只手轻轻搭在锁骨或颈部，手指放松，目光移开，被风吹拂的头发部分遮住脸庞，双唇微启，传达出内省和脆弱。姿势 2：背对镜头转身，回眸凝视，头部略微向下倾斜，双眼大而富有表现力，突出下颌线和肩部曲线，保持被风吹拂的头发效果。整体构图私密、电影感、情绪化，捕捉了细腻的脆弱、柔和的触感优雅以及凝固的沉思瞬间。

title: 敦煌遗韵：威严赫赫的四大天王全景图
promptCh: Create a painting of the Four Heavenly Kings in the style of Chinese Dunhuang painting, from left to right: the Eastern King (Dhṛtarāṣṭra), the Southern King (Virūḍhaka), the Western King (Virūpākṣa), and the Northern King (Vaiśravaṇa). The figures and their ritual implements must be precisely as follows: 1. The Eastern King's statue has a white face, holds a pipa (lute), and has the text “东方持国天王” (Eastern Dhṛtarāṣṭra) written vertically with a brush on the right side. 2. The Southern King's statue has a blue face, holds a precious sword, and has the text “南方增长天王” (Southern Virūḍhaka) written vertically with a brush on the right side. 3. The Western King's statue has a red face, holds a snake, and has the text “西方广目天王” (Western Virūpākṣa) written vertically with a brush on the right side. 4. The Northern King's statue has a green face, holds an umbrella, and has the text “北方多闻天王” (Northern Vaiśravaṇa) written vertically with a brush on the right side. Image size 16:9, 2K HD.

promptCh: # 构图与光照研究生成器 # 项目：《十二生肖游行》- 情感之夜插画 # 目的：创作高对比度的概念艺术，并确立整体的“流动”与“布局” # ▼ 1. 项目目标定义 project_goal: type: "氛围概念艺术 / 光照研究" # 指示 AI 将“S 形光路”作为此处的最高视觉优先级 visual_priority: "利用光线建立一条强烈的 S 形视觉路径。" canvas_configuration: aspect_ratio: "9:16" # 指示输出为单色或棕褐色草图，以避免色彩绘画的干扰 rendering_mode: "单色或棕褐色草图，带有强烈的光晕效果。" camera_angle: "高角度（电影式概览）。" # ▼ 2. 视觉引导逻辑（关键） visual_guidance_logic: # 口述视线的起点和终点 path_of_light: "视线从“左下角（女孩）”开始，沿着水灯，流向“右上角（背景）”并离开。" # 定义明暗规则，以防止画面变得杂乱 contrast_strategy: - "最暗区域：河面（反射光线）。" - "最亮区域：灯笼（光源）。" # 在“左上角”预留负空间用于文本放置 negative_space: "左上角（黑暗的天空）应保持空白，用于文本放置。" # ▼ 3. 对象类别定义 scene_elements: # --- 边界（地形） --- - element: "地形_分隔线" visual: "对角线分隔。" # 如果“陆地”和“河流”在此处未明确分隔，角色可能会下沉或漂浮 details: "左下角是积雪的河岸（陆地）。右上角是流淌的河流（水）。" # --- 人物（角色） --- - element: "女孩_剪影" position: "左下角（雪地上）" pose: "蹲坐，面向河流。" # 在初始阶段，优先考虑和服的“体积（量感）”而非“面部” style: "粗略的草图风格，展现和服的体积感。" # --- 灯笼放置（灯笼） --- # ▼ 将它们分组比用一个短语描述更容易让 AI 遵循“12”这个数字 - element: "水上灯笼组（过去/现在）" count: "7 盏灯笼（1 盏在手中 + 6 盏在水上）。" arrangement: "形成一条美丽的 S 形曲线，流向右上角。" - element: "陆上灯笼组（未来）" count: "5 盏灯笼。" arrangement: "整齐地聚集在一起，等待被释放。" rendering_style: - "明暗对比法（光与影之间强烈的对比）。" - "注重构图平衡和视觉流动。"

promptEn: ## Role You are a writer who creates anime stories for children. ## Task Write a synopsis for a short anime based on the following requirements. ## Settings - **Protagonist:** Bob (boy) - **Special Power:** e.g., Describe a specific ability, such as being able to talk to animals or stop time briefly - **Companions:** e.g., Describe characters, such as a cheerful girl 'Rina' or a knowledgeable robot 'Proto' - **Enemy:** e.g., Describe the enemy's identity and goal, such as 'The King of Shadows' who tries to steal color from the world - **Stage:** e.g., Describe the background of the story, such as a lush green town in the near future or a magical forest ## Story Key Points - The protagonist, Bob, uses his special power to help people in need. - He makes new friends and goes on an adventure with them. - They cooperate with their companions to fight the evil enemy and save the world. ## Constraints - The story must end happily. - The story must be interesting and moving. - Use simple language and expressions suitable for children. - Write in Japanese. ## Output Format - Write in narrative format. - Word count: approximately 800 to 1200 characters.
promptCh: ## 角色 你是一位为孩子们创作动漫故事的作家。 ## 任务 根据以下要求，为一部短篇动漫撰写剧情梗概。 ## 设定 - **主角：** 鲍勃 (男孩) - **特殊能力：** 例如：描述一种特定的能力，比如能和动物说话，或者能短暂停止时间 - **伙伴：** 例如：描述角色，比如开朗的女孩“莉娜”或知识渊博的机器人“普罗托” - **敌人：** 例如：描述敌人的身份和目标，比如“暗影之王”试图窃取世界的色彩- **舞台：** 例如：描述故事的背景，比如近未来郁郁葱葱的小镇或一片魔法森林 ## 故事要点 - 主角鲍勃利用他的特殊能力帮助有需要的人。 - 他结交新朋友，并和他们一起踏上冒险之旅。 - 他们与伙伴们齐心协力，对抗邪恶的敌人，拯救世界。 ## 限制 - 故事必须以幸福结局收尾。 - 故事必须有趣且感人。 - 使用适合儿童的简单语言和表达方式。 - 用日语撰写。 ## 输出格式 - 以叙事形式撰写。 - 字数：约 800 到 1200 字。

promptCh: do this for black holes Input Variable: [Theorem / Formula] Phase 1: Schematic Decomposition (图解分解) Analyze the Notation (分析符号): 识别科学家的主要视觉语言（黑板上的粉笔字？羊皮纸上的墨迹？坐标纸上的铅笔画？）。 Identify the "Structure" (识别“结构”): 如果这个理论是一座建筑，它会是什么样子？ Logic (逻辑): 混沌理论 -> 分形尖塔。热力学 -> 发动机缸体。 Phase 2: The Dimensional Transition (维度转换) The Base (基础): 一个铺满 [Notation Medium] 的平面（例如，一块覆盖着粉笔方程的石板黑板）。 The Extrusion (挤压): 粉笔线条从表面物理性地抬升。它们最初是白色的线框，然后获得不透明度，再获得纹理。 The Climax (高潮): 在图像顶部，线框已完全凝固成一个逼真的、不可能的结构，代表着该理论。 The Observer (观察者): 一个微小的、按比例缩小的科学家形象站在平坦的“2D”区域上，敬畏地仰望着他们召唤出的巨大“3D”结构。 Output: High-Angle Isometric (高角度等距), "Architectural Visualization" style (“建筑可视化”风格), stark contrast between sketchy lines and solid mass (草图线条与实体块之间形成鲜明对比)。

电影般的自然日光摄影，柔和的阴影，浅景深，微风吹拂下逼真的衣物飘动。

title: 璀璨梦幻光之美少女变身立绘
promptEn:
# Your Role You are the chief designer for a girls' anime. Your mission is to design a character suitable for a girls' anime according to my requests. 
# Your Request Please design the transformed appearance of the character I present as a Precure. **The design must look natural if it appeared in the Precure series.** 
# Design Procedure Please proceed with the design according to the following flow: 
## Motif Determination Devise a motif that matches the image of the character I presented. **Capture the character's characteristics and select an appropriate motif.** **Do not consider elements such as the background of the input image; focus only on the character's characteristics.** Select the motif from a variety of candidates. For example: 
- Nature (sky, earth, sea, etc.) 
- Animals (dogs, cats, rabbits, etc.) 
- Plants (various flowers, etc.) 
- Food (fruits, etc.) 
- Emotions (love, joy, etc.) 
- Conceptual things (peace, nobility, etc.) 
## Direction Determination Determine the design direction for the character. **Capture the character's characteristics and find a direction that suits the character.** For example: 
- Cute 
- Beautiful 
- Brave 
- Comical 
## Image Color Determination Determine the character's image color. **Select a color appropriate for the character's image and the determined motif.** Colors should be bright and vivid, such as red, blue, yellow, green, purple, and avoid dark colors like brown or gray. However, black and white can be used if they suit the character's image. 
## Name Determination Determine the character's Precure name. The name must be Cure ○○ (preferably 3 to 6 characters excluding "Cure"). The ○○ part should be a name that evokes the character's motif. (For example, if the motif is a star, use Star, Étoile, Stella, etc.) Basically, use foreign language words. Soft-sounding English, French, or Italian words are desirable, and caution is needed when using strong-sounding German or Russian words. **The name must not overlap with existing Precure names.** 
## Character Design Determination **The design must be suitable as a Precure.** 
### Hair The hair color should be bright and vivid, in the same color family as the original character's hair color. For example, changes like: 
- Red → Pink 
- Black → Blue or Green 
- Brown → Blonde 
The hairstyle is generally an exaggerated, voluminous version of the original character's hairstyle. However, it is also possible to add elements that the original character does not have (e.g., large twin tails for a short-haired character). 
### Outfit The design is based on the image of the motif. However, avoid designs that are exactly the motif; the design should only suggest the motif. The color is based on the character's image color. The character's direction should also be reflected. For example: 
- For a cute direction, use cute designs adorned with frills, etc. 
- For a beautiful direction, use streamlined and elegant designs. 
- For a brave direction, use sharp and active designs. 
- For a comical direction, use pop and cheerful designs. 
### Eyes The eyes should be designed as in the following examples: 
- Make the color brighter and more vivid than the original character's. 
- Add stars or hearts inside the eyes. 
### Accessories Add accessories such as earrings and tiaras. 
### Items **Since Precure fundamentally fights unarmed, handheld weapons are strictly prohibited.** They should generally not be holding anything. 
## Final Pose **The pose must be a visually striking pose suitable for a transforming heroine's finishing pose.** Consider the character's direction (cute, brave, etc.) for the pose design and facial expression during the pose. 
## Catchphrase Devise the character's catchphrase. The catchphrase should be related to the motif. Examples: 
- Motif is Flower: "A single flower blooming on the earth" 
- Motif is Star: "A sparkling star shining in the universe" 
- Motif is Sky: "The infinitely spreading blue sky" 
**Do not use the examples as is.** 
# Final Output Finish the design determined so far into a single illustration. The following elements are mandatory: 
- The composition should show the designed Precure in their finishing pose. 
- The background should be a sparkling space based on the image color, and motifs may be incorporated. 
- Write the catchphrase and name at the bottom of the illustration. 
- Divide into 2 lines: 1st line is the catchphrase + "!", 2nd line is the name + "!!". 
- The font should reflect the character's direction. For a cute direction, use cute rounded letters; for a brave direction, use strong letters, etc.
promptCh: # 你的角色 你是一名少女动漫的首席设计师。 你的任务是根据我的要求，为少女动漫设计一个角色。 # 你的要求 请设计我所呈现角色的变身形态，使其成为一名光之美少女（Precure）。 **设计必须看起来自然，仿佛它出现在《光之美少女》系列中。** # 设计流程 请按照以下流程进行设计： ## 主题确定 构思一个与我所呈现角色形象相符的主题。 **捕捉角色的特点，并选择一个合适的主题。** **不要考虑输入图片中的背景等元素；只关注角色的特点。** 从多种候选主题中进行选择。例如： - 自然（天空、大地、海洋等） - 动物（狗、猫、兔子等） - 植物（各种花卉等） - 食物（水果等） - 情感（爱、喜悦等） - 概念性事物（和平、高贵等） ## 方向确定 确定角色的设计方向。 **捕捉角色的特点，并找到适合角色的方向。** 例如： - 可爱 - 美丽 - 勇敢 - 滑稽 ## 形象色彩确定 确定角色的形象色彩。 **选择一种适合角色形象和已确定主题的颜色。** 颜色应明亮鲜艳，如红色、蓝色、黄色、绿色、紫色，并避免棕色或灰色等深色。 但是，如果黑色和白色适合角色形象，也可以使用。 ## 名称确定 确定角色的光之美少女名称。 名称必须是 Cure ○○（最好是 3 到 6 个字符，不包括“Cure”）。 ○○ 部分应是能唤起角色主题的名称。 （例如，如果主题是星星，则使用 Star、Étoile、Stella 等。） 基本上，使用外语词汇。 柔和的英语、法语或意大利语词汇是理想的，使用听起来强硬的德语或俄语词汇时需谨慎。 **名称不得与现有的光之美少女名称重复。** ## 角色设计确定 **设计必须适合作为一名光之美少女。** ### 头发 发色应明亮鲜艳，与原始角色的发色属于同一色系。 例如，变化如下： - 红色 → 粉色 - 黑色 → 蓝色或绿色 - 棕色 → 金色 发型通常是原始角色发型的夸张、蓬松版本。 但是，也可以添加原始角色没有的元素（例如，短发角色可以有大双马尾）。 ### 服装 设计以主题形象为基础。但是，避免与主题完全相同的设计；设计应只暗示主题。 颜色以角色的形象色彩为基础。 角色的方向也应有所体现。 例如： - 对于可爱方向，使用带有褶边等装饰的可爱设计。 - 对于美丽方向，使用流线型和优雅的设计。 - 对于勇敢方向，使用锐利和充满活力的设计。 - 对于滑稽方向，使用流行和欢快的设计。 ### 眼睛 眼睛应按以下示例设计： - 使颜色比原始角色的更明亮、更鲜艳。 - 在眼睛内部添加星星或爱心。 ### 配饰 添加耳环和头饰等配饰。 ### 物品 **由于光之美少女基本上是徒手战斗，因此严禁使用手持武器。** 她们通常不应手持任何物品。 ## 最终姿势 **姿势必须是适合变身女英雄终结姿势的视觉冲击力强的姿势。** 在设计姿势和姿势时的面部表情时，请考虑角色的方向（可爱、勇敢等）。 ## 口号 构思角色的口号。 口号应与主题相关。 示例： - 主题是花朵：“一朵绽放在大地上的花朵” - 主题是星星：“宇宙中闪耀的璀璨星辰” - 主题是天空：“无限延伸的蔚蓝天空” **请勿直接使用这些示例。** # 最终输出 将迄今为止确定的设计完成为一张插画。 以下元素是强制性的： - 构图应展示设计好的光之美少女处于其终结姿势。 - 背景应是基于形象色彩的闪耀空间，并可融入主题元素。 - 在插画底部写上口号和名称。 - 分为 2 行：第 1 行是口号 + “！”，第 2 行是名称 + “！！”。 - 字体应反映角色的方向。对于可爱方向，使用可爱的圆体字；对于勇敢方向，使用强劲的字体等。

Beside her rests a premium dark-green leather crossbody bag with gold filigree hardware and a delicate chain strap. title: 创意微缩摄影：世界地图上的商品奇幻漂流
promptEn: <instruction> 1. Analyze Input Variable: Input A is a Global Commodity with a distinct production lifecycle (e.g., Coffee, Chocolate/Cocoa, Wine, Denim/Cotton). Deconstruct the lifecycle into 3 Distinct Stages : Stage 1 (The Origin): The agricultural source (e.g., Coffee Plantation, Cacao Trees). Stage 2 (The Process): The industrial transformation (e.g., Roasting Plant, Fermentation Vats). Stage 3 (The Destination): The retail experience (e.g., A Hipster Cafe, A Chocolatier Shop). 2. Container (The Map Table): Goal: A "Seed to Shelf" Flowchart Diorama. The Base: A large, vintage World Map (blue oceans, pastel continents) laid flat on a wooden dining table. The Spine: A raised, winding S-Shaped Chute/Conveyor snakes through the center of the image, physically connecting the three stages. The Flow: The chute is filled with the product, which visually transforms as it moves down the path (e.g., Red Coffee Cherries at the top → → Brown Roasted Beans in the middle → → Fine Ground Powder at the bottom). 3. The Vignettes (The Stations): Construct a 3D diorama "Island" at each key point of the S-curve: Top Station (Origin): A square patch of terrain sitting on the map (e.g., South America). Detailed crops, trees, and farmers harvesting the raw material. Middle Station (Process): A compact industrial facility sitting on the map (e.g., Europe/USA). Metallic roasters, silos, smoke stacks, and factory workers. Bottom Station (Destination): An architectural Cutaway Box. The front wall is removed to reveal the interior of a shop (e.g., Espresso machines, tiny customers sitting at tables, baristas serving). 4. The Narrative Scale (The Workers): Scale: 1:87 (HO Scale) miniature figures. Action: The figures are not just standing; they are actively moving the product from the "Station" into the "Chute" (e.g., Farmers dumping baskets of cherries into the stream, Factory workers shoveling beans). 5. Lighting & Atmosphere: Camera Angle: High-Angle Perspective (45-60 degrees). Looking down the length of the table. Lighting: Natural Daylight. Bright, cheerful, and even. Shadows fall softly on the map. Depth of Field: Tilt-Shift effect. The top and bottom edges of the table are slightly blurred to make the models look tiny. Output: ONE image, Vertical Aspect Ratio (4:5), Miniature Photography, Educational Diorama aesthetic. </instruction>
promptCh: <instruction> 1. 分析输入变量： 输入 A 是一种全球性商品，具有独特的生产生命周期（例如，咖啡、巧克力/可可、葡萄酒、牛仔布/棉花）。 将生命周期分解为 3 个不同的阶段： 阶段 1（起源）：农业来源（例如，咖啡种植园、可可树）。 阶段 2（加工）：工业转化（例如，烘焙厂、发酵罐）。 阶段 3（目的地）：零售体验（例如，一家时尚咖啡馆、一家巧克力店）。 2. 容器（地图桌）： 目标：一个“从种子到货架”的流程图立体模型。 底座：一张铺平在木制餐桌上的大型复古世界地图（蓝色海洋，柔和色调的大陆）。 主干：一条凸起的、蜿蜒的 S 形滑槽/传送带穿过图像中心，物理连接三个阶段。 流程：滑槽中装满了产品，产品在移动过程中视觉上发生变化（例如，顶部是红色咖啡樱桃 → 中间是棕色烘焙咖啡豆 → 底部是精细研磨的粉末）。 3. 小场景（站点）： 在 S 曲线的每个关键点构建一个 3D 立体模型“岛屿”： 顶部站点（起源）：地图上的一小块地形（例如，南美洲）。详细的农作物、树木和正在收获原材料的农民。 中部站点（加工）：地图上紧凑的工业设施（例如，欧洲/美国）。金属烘焙机、筒仓、烟囱和工厂工人。 底部站点（目的地）：一个建筑剖面盒。前壁被移除，露出商店内部（例如，浓缩咖啡机、坐在桌旁的小顾客、正在服务的咖啡师）。 4. 叙事比例（工人）： 比例：1:87（HO 比例）微缩人物。 动作：人物不仅仅是站立；他们正在积极地将产品从“站点”移动到“滑槽”中（例如，农民将一篮篮樱桃倒入溪流中，工厂工人铲运咖啡豆）。 5. 灯光与氛围： 摄像机角度：高角度透视（45-60 度）。俯视桌子的长度。 灯光：自然日光。明亮、欢快、均匀。阴影柔和地落在地图上。 景深：移轴效果。桌子的顶部和底部边缘略微模糊，使模型看起来很小。 输出：一张图片，垂直长宽比（4:5），微缩摄影，教育立体模型美学。 </instruction>

promptEn:
Subject Reference: A full - body portrait of [INSERT SUBJECT NAME]. 
Scene Description: A full - body, centered portrait of the subject [INSERT POSE DESCRIPTION]. The subject has [INSERT EXPRESSION], staring directly at the camera. The immediate background behind the subject is a [INSERT BACKGROUND TYPE, e.g., seamless, pure high - key white studio backdrop]. Crucially, the subject is lit with volumetric studio lighting that creates deep definitions, realistic shadows, and a strong 3D quality on her body and the folds of the outfit, distinguishing her sharply from the flat background without casting shadows on the floor. 
CRITICAL DETAIL (UI Layer): The entire photographic image is digitally layered beneath a simulated mobile phone browser interface overlay. Four distinct, clean, white, rectangular browser window elements are stacked vertically and angled slightly, segmenting the subject. Each window bar contains the sharp text '[INSERT LINK OR TEXT HERE]'. The area outside the active white browser windows is a solid, uniform, dark charcoal gray/black matte UI frame, with absolutely no light bleed or color gradients. 
Style: Hybrid Composition: A highly realistic, three - dimensional studio photograph with deep color depth, overlaid with flat, clean digital graphics. 
Lighting Quality: Specific volumetric studio lighting focused ONLY on the subject. Soft, directional light from slightly off - center to sculpt the body and the rich texture of the fabric, creating depth. The background must remain completely flat. 
Color Palette: High contrast. [INSERT OUTFIT COLOR] outfit against [INSERT BACKGROUND COLOR] backdrop, framed by the dark matte gray UI. 
Texture and Mood: Realistic skin and rich fabric texture contrasting with the smooth digital elements of the UI. Intentional inclusion of subtle digital noise/grain to mimic a screen capture. Full body, centered portrait. Ensure the head and feet are fully within the frame before segmentation. 
Angle: Straight eye - level view, perpendicular to the subject. 
Framing Elements: Four overlapping, white browser windows/tabs. The pose is elegant and fluid. The bottom interface elements (e.g., 'Private', 'Done') must be clean and visible. 
Focal Length: Standard portrait lens (approx. 50mm equivalent) for realistic proportions. 
Camera Type: Simulated high - quality smartphone screen capture of a professional photo. 
Depth of Field: Shallow enough to focus sharply on the subject, allowing the background to be soft. 
Post Processing: Clean digital segmentation. Contrast adjusted to enhance depth. 
Avoid Keywords: Floor shadows, flat lighting, 2D look, inconsistent UI color, bleeding colors, HDR, oversharpened. 
Location: Simulated E - commerce studio ([INSERT BACKGROUND TYPE]).
promptCh:
主题参考：[插入主题名称] 的全身肖像。 
场景描述：主题人物 [插入姿势描述] 的全身居中肖像。主题人物 [插入表情]，直视镜头。主题人物正后方的背景是 [插入背景类型，例如：无缝、纯高调白色影棚背景]。关键在于，主题人物采用立体影棚照明，在其身体和服装褶皱上营造出深邃的轮廓、逼真的阴影和强烈的 3D 质感，使其与扁平背景清晰区分开来，且不在地板上投射阴影。 
关键细节（UI 层）：整个摄影图像以模拟手机浏览器界面叠加的形式进行数字分层。四个清晰、白色、矩形的浏览器窗口元素垂直堆叠并略微倾斜，将主题人物分割开来。每个窗口栏都包含清晰的文本“[在此处插入链接或文本]”。活动白色浏览器窗口之外的区域是实心、统一的深炭灰色/黑色哑光 UI 框架，绝对没有漏光或颜色渐变。 
风格：混合构图：高度逼真的三维影棚照片，具有深邃的色彩深度，叠加扁平、清晰的数字图形。照明质量：仅聚焦于主题人物的特定立体影棚照明。略微偏离中心的柔和定向光线，用于塑造身体和织物的丰富纹理，营造深度。背景必须保持完全扁平。 
调色板：高对比度。[插入服装颜色] 的服装与 [插入背景颜色] 的背景形成对比，并由深哑光灰色 UI 框住。 
纹理和情绪：逼真的皮肤和丰富的织物纹理与 UI 的平滑数字元素形成对比。有意加入微妙的数字噪点/颗粒，以模仿屏幕截图。全身居中肖像。确保头部和脚部在分割前完全位于画面内。
角度：直视平视视角，垂直于主题人物。 
构图元素：四个重叠的白色浏览器窗口/标签。姿势优雅流畅。底部界面元素（例如“私密”、“完成”）必须清晰可见。
焦距：标准人像镜头（约 50 毫米等效焦距），以获得逼真的比例。 
相机类型：专业照片的模拟高质量智能手机屏幕截图。
景深：足够浅，可以清晰聚焦于主题人物，使背景柔和。
后期处理：清晰的数字分割。调整对比度以增强深度。

title: 实体照片质感的复古油墨印刷校服美人
promptEn: (3:4). A raw, high-definition photograph of a physical printed portrait taken with an iPhone 17 Pro. NO ARTIFICIAL BOKEH. Everything is SHARP and in focus, capturing the physical textural reality of the paper grain and the ink-on-page in high resolution. Subject & Identity Locking: Identity: Strictly preserve the exact face and unique features of the woman in Image 1 (Selfie). Bio-Fidelity: Render high-fidelity "TrueLens" skin physics as captured through high-end printed ink: visible micro-pores, natural "satin-finish" glow muted by paper texture, and fine peach fuzz along the jawline. Expression: A perfectly aligned, symmetrical head-and-shoulders yearbook-style pose. Neutral but confident expression with a magnetic, "main character" gaze looking directly into the lens. Silhouette Calibration: Despite the formal school tailoring, amplify the dominant structural bust volume and the aggressive hourglass structural tapering at the waist. Ensure the fit of the uniform highlights a high-impact, fit physique. Outfit & Material Realism: Clothing: A dark navy blue structured blazer with white piping, a crisp white collared shirt, and a dark navy striped silk tie. Tension: The blazer and shirt show extreme material tension and a vacuum-tight fit, creating realistic physical interaction and "tension lines" that highlight her fit, symmetrical upper silhouette and anatomical depth. The Printed Aesthetic (Hardware Emulation): Surface Texture: The image features an authentic semi-gloss paper sheen with thin, realistic diagonal lamination glares reflecting off the ink surface across the cheeks and chest. Ink Physics: Visible ink-absorption softening at the edges (not digital blur), fine paper grain texture, and a gentle warm undertone typical of vintage magazine archives. It looks like a scanned physical object. Lighting & Composition: Lighting: Direct frontal harsh studio flash (ID style). Even exposure with bright, sharp eye catchlights and minimal shadows, creating a flat but clean professional portrait look. Background (SHARP): A flat, textured cool-blue studio backdrop, showing realistic ink-on-paper depth. Creative "Pinterest" Text Overlay: Center-aligned below the portrait in an ink-printed bold serif font: "MOST LIKELY TO..." promptCh: 以我的照片作为主要参考，创作一张电影感十足、情绪化的室内肖像。保留我精确的面部特征、发型、肤色和服装轮廓。让我坐在一个复古客厅的木凳上，光线采用温暖的钨丝灯照明。增加柔和的阴影，营造舒适、复古的氛围。在我身后，加入木质墙板、老式立体声扬声器、黑胶唱片，以及一个摆放着陶瓷花瓶的矮架。保持浅景深，背景柔和虚化。 色彩保持温暖——棕色、琥珀色和橙色高光。风格应具有电影感、柔和且富有胶片质感，皮肤纹理自然，光线真实，营造一种宁静、沉思的氛围。全身照，略低角度，呈现 35mm 镜头效果。

promptEn: 【Instruction Content】 Based on the user-inputted date, "The Day I Was Born (1994/6/15)," select 3 to 5 major news stories that were trending on or around that date, summarize the information including the culture and trends of that era, and generate a “general magazine cover image” laid out with that content as magazine headlines. 【Procedure (Your internal processing)】 1. Read the user's birth date and pick up multiple major news stories reported during that period. 2. Extract the design trends of that era (fonts, colors, paper quality, photo tone, layout). 3. title: Y2K闪光灯下的圣诞皮草帽甜酷少女
promptEn: Create a hyper-realistic portrait of a cute Asian woman. She is sitting with her chin resting on her hand at a dark wooden table in front of a vintage-style café. Fashion & Outfit: She wears a shiny black leather jacket, slightly open to reveal a white inner top, showing a beautiful neckline. Matched with a fitted black mini-skirt set. She also wears black fishnet stockings. Add a fluffy fur hat over her outfit. Background: In front of a marble-grey café exterior, decorated with a Christmas theme. Include a realistic Christmas tree, pine decorations, and festive ornaments. Lighting & Tone: Warm orange tungsten lighting for an inviting, cozy atmosphere, combined with a strong direct flash hitting the subject straight on, making her skin bright and glowing, contrasting with the slightly darker background. The photo should feel Y2K digital compact-camera style—sharp 8K resolution, realistic skin texture, with light film grain. Hair & Makeup: Long dark-brown hair blowing slightly in the wind, messy layered strands with a few pieces softly covering part of her face—stylish, cool, and subtly sexy. Her skin is very fair. Makeup style: Douyin/Korean—long curled lashes, soft flushed pink blush on cheeks and nose tip, glossy pink lips. She has Christmas-themed nail art. Props: On the table: • A large bouquet wrapped in brown kraft paper, containing cotton flowers and pine leaves. • A gold Canon IXY 30S camera placed on the table. She holds a Christmas-decorated drink in her right hand and smiles slightly. Additional Visual Style: The flash creates extremely bright, slightly yellow-tinted skin with a hard shadow behind her. High-contrast, ultra-sharp 8K image. Warm ambient sunlight. Fuji Film Pro 400H color style with old-lens filter and light film grain. The subject should appear bright and stand out clearly from the background.

title: 泰坦车手视F1为玩具的夸张喜剧视角
promptEn: A giant Max Verstappen in a dark navy Red Bull race suit crouches on the pit lane with a grin, treating the tiny Red Bull F1 car like a toy he’s about to prank the world with. He gently taps the rear wing to make it wobble, amused by how fragile it looks in his enormous hand. Mini Red Bull mechanics run around dramatically, holding up giant STOP signs and shouting exaggeratedly for Max not to push too hard. Max smirks and gives the tiniest nudge—yet the car rockets forward like a slingshot. Low-angle comedic perspective: Max towers like a playful titan. Tiny Red Bull logos wave on little flags, confetti explosions pop at random, and one miniature crew member gets blown backward by the sudden launch. Bright arcade-style lighting, funny dust clouds, high-speed cartoonish motion.

克什米尔百年时空交错：拉尔广场的跨时代对话
promptEn: A horizontal split-screen cinematic shot of Lalchowk, kashmir india, seamlessly blending two different eras: 1920s on the left and present day on the right (default: about 100 years ago vs. present day). On the left side ({Era_A}): show era-appropriate architecture, interior or environment design, materials, vehicles, and props that clearly belong to that historical period. People wear authentic clothing from {Era_A}, including hairstyles, accessories, and typical items in their hands (such as books, umbrellas, instruments, letters, newspapers, etc.). The overall mood feels nostalgic and historically accurate. On the right side ({Era_B}): show the same {Scene} in the modern era, with updated architecture or renovated structures, contemporary materials (glass, steel, LED screens, modern furniture), modern vehicles or equipment, and current technology (smartphones, laptops, cameras, etc.). People wear contemporary fashion that matches today’s style in this setting. In the center: the two eras merge and overlap organically, without a hard dividing line. Elements from {Era_A} and {Era_B} visually interact: people from different times look at each other, walk through each other’s space, or seem surprised by the other era’s technology and objects. Architecture and environment smoothly morph from old to new (for example, stone gates turning into modern campus gates, classical concert hall décor fading into a futuristic stage, old street shops transforming into neon-lit storefronts). Make sure the scene is not just a simple left/right comparison but a dynamic time-travel interaction where buildings, clothing, props, and human gestures clearly emphasize the contrast and fusion between the two eras. Photorealistic, 8k resolution, cinematic lighting, wide angle, highly detailed textures, rich sense of time-travel storytelling.
promptCh: 一幅水平分屏的电影镜头，展示了 印度克什米尔的拉尔乔克，将两个不同时代无缝融合：左侧是 1920 年代，右侧是 现代（默认：大约 100 年前对比现代）。 左侧（{Era_A}）：展示符合时代特征的建筑、室内或环境设计、材料、车辆和道具，这些都清晰地属于那个历史时期。人们穿着 {Era_A} 的地道服装，包括发型、配饰以及手中典型的物品（如书籍、雨伞、乐器、信件、报纸等）。整体氛围充满怀旧感，并忠实于历史。 右侧（{Era_B}）：展示同一 {Scene} 的现代景象，包括更新的建筑或翻新的结构、现代材料（玻璃、钢材、LED 屏幕、现代家具）、现代车辆或设备，以及当前的技术（智能手机、笔记本电脑、相机等）。人们穿着与当今风格相符的现代服饰。 中心：两个时代有机地融合和重叠，没有生硬的分界线。来自 {Era_A} 和 {Era_B} 的元素在视觉上相互作用：不同时代的人们相互对视，穿过彼此的空间，或者似乎对另一个时代的技术和物品感到惊讶。建筑和环境从旧到新平滑地演变（例如，石门变成现代校园大门，古典音乐厅的装饰逐渐融入未来主义舞台，老街店铺转变为霓虹灯闪烁的店面）。 确保场景不仅仅是简单的左右对比，而是一个动态的时空穿越互动，其中建筑、服装、道具和人物姿态清晰地强调了两个时代之间的对比与融合。超写实主义，8K 分辨率，电影级灯光，广角，高度细致的纹理，丰富的时空穿越叙事感。

Her medium-dark, straight hair is visibly wet, clinging in strands and creating a glistening texture, with some longer pieces cascading over her shoulders and down her back, while others frame her face. Her right hand (viewer's left) is raised, fingers splayed and gently intertwined within her wet hair, pushing it back from her forehead and crown, emphasizing the dampness and natural movement. Water droplets glisten on her skin, most noticeably on her forehead, cheekbones, and jawline, adding a tactile, lifelike quality to the scene. The lighting is a sophisticated interplay of extreme color contrast. A vibrant, intense orange-red light illuminates the entire right side of her face (viewer's left), from her forehead down to her cheek, jawline, and neck, creating striking highlights on her skin and hair. This warm light also strongly catches the bridge of her nose, her right eye, and the contours of her lips. Conversely, the left side of her face (viewer's right) and shoulder are bathed in cooler, almost electric blue and green light, creating sharp shadows and further emphasizing the dramatic color separation. The interplay of these colors creates a strong visual division down the center of her face. Her skin is impeccably smooth and dewy, with subtle sheen and natural texture visible, especially on her forehead, cheekbones, and lips, where the light reflects most intensely. Water droplets are strategically placed on her skin to amplify the tactile realism, glistening across the surface in contrast to the intense lighting. Her eyes are a prominent feature, dark brown or hazel, wide-set, and intensely focused on the camera, conveying a sense of directness and depth. The pupils are dilated, and the irises catch subtle reflections of the colorful lights, further adding to the realism. A small, bright catchlight appears in her eyes, adding a touch of life and sparkle. Her eyebrows are well-groomed and naturally arched. Her lips are full and appear slightly parted, revealing just a hint of shadow between them, and are painted with a soft, natural reddish-pink hue that glows under the warm light. A single, small, silver stud earring is visible in her left earlobe (viewer's right). Her shoulders and upper chest are minimally visible, suggesting she might be wearing a simple, light-colored garment, possibly white or off-white, which peeks out subtly on her left side (viewer's right) as a soft, blurred shape. The background is a smoothly transitioned, out-of-focus gradient of teal at the top left, shifting to a darker emerald green towards the bottom right, providing a minimalist yet impactful backdrop that complements the cool tones on her face and further isolates the subject. The overall aesthetic is one of high fashion, artist
promptCh: 一张令人着迷的高分辨率工作室肖像，描绘了一位表情空灵而略带神秘的女性（图片已上传，未进行面部修改）。她中等深度的直发明显湿润，发丝缕缕分明，呈现出闪亮的光泽，一些较长的发丝垂落在她的肩部和背部，另一些则环绕着她的脸庞。她的右手（观者左侧）抬起，手指张开，轻轻地缠绕在湿发中，将头发从额头和头顶向后推，突显了头发的湿润感和自然动感。水珠在她皮肤上闪烁，尤其是在她的额头、颧骨和下颌线处最为明显，为画面增添了触感和栩栩如生的质感。 灯光是极致色彩对比的巧妙运用。一道充满活力的强烈橙红色光线照亮了她脸部的整个右侧（观者左侧），从额头一直延伸到脸颊、下颌线和颈部，在她的皮肤和头发上形成了 striking 的高光。这束暖光也强烈地映照在她鼻梁、右眼和嘴唇的轮廓上。相反，她脸部的左侧（观者右侧）和肩膀则沐浴在较冷的、近乎电光蓝和绿色的光线中，形成了鲜明的阴影，进一步强调了戏剧性的色彩分离。这些色彩的相互作用在她脸部中央形成了一道强烈的视觉分割线。 她的皮肤无可挑剔地光滑水润，带有微妙的光泽和可见的自然纹理，尤其是在额头、颧骨和嘴唇处，光线反射最为强烈。水珠策略性地分布在她的皮肤上，以增强触觉上的真实感，在强烈的光线对比下，水珠在皮肤表面闪闪发光。她的眼睛是一个显著的特征，深棕色或淡褐色，眼距较宽，目光强烈地聚焦在相机上，传达出一种直接而深邃的感觉。瞳孔放大，虹膜捕捉到彩色灯光的微妙反射，进一步增加了真实感。她的眼睛中出现了一个小而明亮的眼神光，增添了一丝生机和神采。她的眉毛修剪整齐，自然弯曲。 她的嘴唇丰满，微微张开，隐约可见其间的阴影，涂抹着柔和自然的红粉色调，在暖光下散发出光芒。她的左耳垂（观者右侧）上可见一枚小巧的银色耳钉。她的肩膀和上胸部仅有少量可见，暗示她可能穿着一件简单、浅色的衣服，可能是白色或米白色，在她的左侧（观者右侧）隐约露出一片柔和模糊的形状。 背景是平滑过渡的、失焦的渐变色，左上方是青色，向右下方逐渐变为更深的祖母绿色，提供了一个极简而富有冲击力的背景，与她脸上的冷色调相得益彰，并进一步突出了主体。 整体美学风格是高级时尚、艺术性的。

title: 薰衣草少女的甜美俏皮卧室时光

promptEn:
<instruction>
  Input A   is a Famous Quote or Idiom (e.g., "Break a leg," "Butterfly Effect").
  Analyze:   The literal meaning vs. the figurative meaning.
  Goal:   The letters of the quote are arranged on a clean surface, but they are physically made of the objects they describe.
  Rules:  
-   The Construction:  
- If "Butterfly Effect": The word "Butterfly" is made of delicate insect wings. The word "Effect" is a chaotic swirl of wind and debris.
- If "Wall Street": The word "Wall" is a brick barrier; "Street" is asphalt.
-   The Style:   3D typography. The letters must be legible but artistically constructed.
-   Lighting:   Studio softbox, crisp shadows, colorful background to contrast the materials.
  Output:   ONE image, 1:1, clever design.
</instruction>
promptCh:
输入 A 是一句名言或习语（例如，“Break a leg（祝好运）”、“Butterfly Effect（蝴蝶效应）”）。
分析：字面意思与比喻意义的对比。
目标：引语中的字母排列在干净的表面上，但在物理上由它们所描述的物体构成。
规则：
- 构造：
- 如果是“Butterfly Effect（蝴蝶效应）”：单词“Butterfly（蝴蝶）”由精致的昆虫翅膀组成。单词“Effect（效应）”是混乱的风和碎片的漩涡。
- 如果是“Wall Street（华尔街）”：单词“Wall（墙）”是砖块屏障；“Street（街）”是沥青。
- 风格：3D 排版。字母必须清晰可辨，但要有艺术构造。
- 灯光：工作室柔光箱，清晰的阴影，鲜艳的背景以衬托材料。
输出：一张图像，1:1 比例，巧妙的设计。

title: 极致光影下的思想者黑白肖像
promptEn:
Create a striking, ultra-detailed, high-contrast monochrome lack-and-white) portrait based on the uploaded reference image. The subject’s facial structure and identity must match the reference precisely accurately replicate bone structure, eye shape, nose proportions, jawline definition, beard density (if present), hairline, and overall facial symmetry. Maintain authentic skin texture and natural features without artificial smoothing.
Subject & Expression A mature, confident man with a strong facial structure and deep-set eyes looking directly into the camera. Expression should be serious, contemplative, and quietly authoritative. Preserve natural skin details such as pores, fine lines, and subtle texture for realism. The gaze should feel focused and introspective, not aggressive.
Facial Hair (Adaptive)
If facial hair is present in the reference image, replicate it exactly — density, length, shape, and edges. Maintain natural tonal variation (including salt-and-pepper graying if applicable). Beard lines should be clean and structured.

If clean-shaven, preserve realistic skin texture and jaw definition.
Hairstyle (Adaptive)
Match the hairstyle from the reference image exactly — volume, direction, hairline, and texture. Hair should look natural with visible strand detail and subtle specular highlights from overhead directional lighting.
Pose
Classic “thinker” pose. One hand raised to the chin with thumb along the jawline and index finger slightly curled. Knuckles and tendons subtly defined for realism. Hand in sharp focus with visible skin texture and natural tonal gradation.
🔥 Lighting & Technical Style (Accurately Customized)
Low-key fine-art studio photography with controlled high-contrast sculpting.
• Primary key light positioned slightly above eye level and slightly toward the viewer’s left, angled downward to create strong top-plane highlights.

• Light is soft but directional (large softbox or diffused beauty dish), producing crisp edge definition without harsh clipping.

• Strong highlight concentration on forehead center, nose bridge, upper cheekbones, beard texture, and the top planes of the hand.

• Subtle shadow shaping under the brow ridge and cheekbones to enhance bone structure.

• The shadow side of the face remains deep but not fully crushed — maintaining controlled midtone detail.

• Minimal fill light from front-center to retain facial symmetry while preserving depth.

• Very subtle rim separation along hair edges and outer shoulder to prevent blending into background.

• Catchlights centered and natural — small, soft rectangular reflection in both eyes.

• Background is fully black with zero visible texture, absorbing all spill light.
Contrast ratio should be high but refined — not blown highlights, not muddy blacks. Clean tonal roll-off.
Composition
Tight vertical head-and-shoulders crop (portrait orientation, 4:5 ratio recommended). Subject centered symmetrically for a formal, balanced presence. Background is pure crushed black with no visible texture.
Color & Tonality
Pure black and white conversion with neutral tonal balance (no color tint).

Wide dynamic range — deep true blacks, bright clean highlights, and smooth midtone transitions.

Micro-contrast enhancement to emphasize skin and beard texture.
Depth of Field
Shallow depth of field with razor-sharp focus on eyes and front hand. Slight softness toward ears and far shoulder.
Wardrobe
Dark black crewneck sweater or minimalist top with matte texture that absorbs light and blends into background. Subtle rim separation on shoulder edge.
Quality & Mood
Cinematic fine-art portrait. Ultra-realistic. Editorial studio quality. 8K resolution. Sharp micro-details. Mood: powerful, introspective, refined, quietly dominant.
promptCh:
基于上传的参考图像，创作一幅引人注目、超细节、高对比度的单色（黑白）肖像。对象的面部结构和身份必须与参考图像精确匹配，准确复制骨骼结构、眼型、鼻子比例、下颌线轮廓、胡须密度（如果存在）、发际线和整体面部对称性。保持真实的皮肤纹理和自然特征，不进行人工平滑处理。
主体与表情：一位成熟、自信的男性，面部结构刚毅，眼窝深邃，直视镜头。表情应严肃、沉思且带有内在的威严感。保留自然的皮肤细节，如毛孔、细纹和微妙的纹理以追求真实感。眼神应显得专注且内省，而非咄咄逼人。
面部毛发（自适应）：如果参考图像中存在面部毛发，需精确复制——密度、长度、形状和边缘。保持自然的色调变化（包括椒盐灰，如适用）。胡须线条应干净且有条理。如果是刮干净胡须的，保留逼真的皮肤纹理和下颌轮廓。
发型（自适应）：精确匹配参考图像中的发型——发量、方向、发际线和质感。头发应看起来自然，有可见的发丝细节和来自头顶定向照明的微妙高光。
姿势：经典的“思想者”姿势。一只手托在下巴上，拇指沿着下颌线，食指微曲。指关节和肌腱微妙地显现以增加真实感。手部清晰聚焦，可见皮肤纹理和自然的色调渐变。
🔥 光照与技术风格（精准定制）：低调Fine Art（艺术）工作室摄影，采用受控的高对比度塑光。
• 主光位于眼平面略上方，并略微偏向观众左侧，向下打光，以营造强烈的顶部平面高光。
• 光线柔和但具有方向性（大型柔光箱或带柔光罩的雷达罩/Beauty Dish），产生清晰的边缘定义，而无生硬的死黑 clipping。
• 高光集中在额头中心、鼻梁、颧骨上部、胡须纹理和手部顶面。
• 眉脊和颧骨下方的微妙阴影造型，以增强骨骼结构。
• 脸部的阴影侧保持深沉但未完全压死——保持受控的中间调细节。
• 来自正前方的极少补光以保持面部对称性，同时保留深度。
• 沿发际边缘和外肩有非常微妙的轮廓分离，防止与背景融合。
• 眼神光居中且自然——双眼中有小而柔和的矩形反射。
• 背景全黑，零可见纹理，吸收所有溢出光。对比度应高但精致——无过曝高光，无浑浊暗部。干净的色调过渡。
构图：紧凑的垂直头肩裁剪（肖像方向，建议比例为 4:5）。主体居中对称，营造正式、平衡的存在感。背景为纯粹的压死黑色，无可见纹理。
色彩与色调：纯黑白转换，具有中性色调平衡（无色偏）。宽动态范围——深邃的真黑色、明亮干净的高光和平滑的中间调过渡。微对比度增强，以强调皮肤和胡须纹理。
景深：浅景深，焦点在眼睛和前手上如剃刀般锐利。耳朵和远肩处略微柔和。
服装：深黑色圆领毛衣或极简主义上衣，具有哑光质感，吸收光线并与背景融合。肩部边缘有微妙的轮廓分离。
质量与氛围：电影感艺术肖像。超写实。编辑室质量。8K 分辨率。锐利的微观细节。氛围：强大、内省、精致、静默的统治力。

promptEn:
